comment: 퀘스트 대사·메일 — tools/gen-quest-messages.mjs 가 만든다(직접 고치지 않는다). 본문은 바닐라 kr.json 의 한국어를 되쓰거나 lang-src/quest-messages.json 의 byKey 에 손으로 적은 것을 쓴다.

entries.687b616db015c21f329bf45f startedMessageT: 밖에서 등 뒤를 조심하게. 삼림은 스캐브가 들끓고 있고, 놈들은 그런 물건을 손에 넣고 싶어 안달일 거야. 빠르게 움직이고, 정신 똑바로 차리게.
entries.687b616db015c21f329bf45f successMessageT: 인상적인 일 처리다. 어디 좀 보자… 깔끔하군. 규격을 글자 하나까지 따랐다. 따로 챙겨 둔 장비가 좀 있다. 리저브에서 나온 좋은 물건이지. 받을 자격이 있다. 아, 세르게이가 한번 들러 보라고 했다. 자네가 관심 가질 만한 새 물건이 들어왔다고 하더군.
entries.68561cd4801134be939e11f6 startedMessageT: 이봐 용병. 내가 말한 대로 그 회계사 사무실은 블랙 나이트 건물 어딘가에 있을 거야. 아마 맨 위층이겠지. 문에 표시된 간판 같은 걸 찾아보게. 눈 똑바로 뜨고 있어.
entries.68561cd4801134be939e11f6 successMessageT: 이건 내 수집품의 훌륭한 한 자리를 차지하겠군! 이런 제작품은 구하기 어렵지.
entries.6833b8bc6f8ce71072c4e703 startedMessageT: 그 인식표들을 심어두고 시체는 깔끔하게 연출해라. 그러고 나서 사라져라. 누가 이걸 추적해 오거나 네가 잡히면, 너는 그냥 혼자 움직인 외로운 늑대다.
entries.6833b8bc6f8ce71072c4e703 successMessageT: 언론이 신나게 물고 있네. PMC 잔혹 행위 이야기가 온 데 널렸지. 제네바는 피를 보자고 소리치고, 우리 자금은 단단히 확보됐네. 잘했군 용병. 여기 보수네.
entries.6833b8bc6f8ce71072c4e703 failMessageText: 자네가 작전을 망쳤네. UNTAR 가 내 목을 조이고 있어. 이 일을 감당하지 못하겠으면 맡지를 말게.
entries.6833b8bc6f8ce71072c4e703 acceptPlayerMes: 이건 속임수가 아니다 — 그들이 어차피 저지를 만행을 기록하는 거다. 삼림으로 가라.
entries.6833b8bc6f8ce71072c4e703 declinePlayerMe: 관심 없다고? 좋아. UNTAR가 결국 밀려나고 스캐브들이 자네 은신처 문을 두드릴 때 말이야? 도와달라고 빌면서 연락하지 말게.
entries.6833b8bc6f8ce71072c4e703 completePlayerM: 완벽해. 현장을 충분히 잘 꾸며 놓으면 세상이 BEAR와 USEC가 저지르는 잔학 행위를 보게 될 거야. 조작에 좀 기대야 했더라도 말이지.
entries.683645245a1c12488166b1a5 startedMessageT: 차량은 콘코르디아 근처에 세워져 있다. 주변을 기어 다니는 사설 민병대를 조심해라. 조용히 처리해라. 그 드라이브가 망가져 있으면 돌아오지 않아도 된다.
entries.683645245a1c12488166b1a5 successMessageT: 서류에서 몇 가지 흘려 주니 스톡홀름이 항생제 10000 회분을 토해 내고 여분 탄약까지 얹어 줬네. 참 후한 사람들이지. 여기 자네 몫이야.
entries.683645245a1c12488166b1a5 acceptPlayerMes: 그 드라이브를 온전한 상태로 나에게 가져다주기만 해라. 패를 잘 쓰면 이건 꽤 괜찮은 벌이가 될 거다.
entries.683645245a1c12488166b1a5 declinePlayerMe: 정말? 시내에서 좀 싸우는 게 그렇게 무섭나? 겁쟁이인 줄은 몰랐다.
entries.683645245a1c12488166b1a5 completePlayerM: 또 하나의 성공한 작전이다. 우리는 대의를 위해 상당히 설득력 있는 주장을 하고 있지. 다음에 들를 때 내 상점을 확인해 봐라. 스웨덴 놈들이 우리 침묵의 대가로 번쩍거리는 새 금속 장난감들을 보내 왔다.
entries.686c25d281071c45d2f8aa44 startedMessageT: 빨리 움직여서 그 적재 목록을 가져와라. 어제 여기 있어야 했던 물건이다.
entries.686c25d281071c45d2f8aa44 successMessageT: 잘했네, 용병. 그 적하목록 건을 끝까지 해냈군. 이제 이 난장판을 정리할 수 있겠네. 보상이네. 곧 일이 더 있을 거야.
entries.686dd4f871840e292fbd1a14 startedMessageT: 가서 잡게. 내 물건을 가로챌 수 있다고 생각한 것만으로도 값을 치르게 해 주게.
entries.686dd4f871840e292fbd1a14 successMessageT: 빌어먹게 잘했네. 솔직히 자네가 해낼 거라고는 생각 못 했어. 날 도와준 보수로 이걸 받게. 이미 몇 개 잃어버렸으니 하나 더 가는 거야 뭐 어떻겠나.
entries.6870170d18b94df2e8700ba0 startedMessageT: 가서 그 상자들에 표시해 둬라, 내 물건을 되찾을 수 있게. 날 실망시키지 말게. 큰 빨간 건물 근처를 확인해 보게!
entries.6870170d18b94df2e8700ba0 successMessageT: 그 상자들에 표식 잘 남겼군. 그 스트레이 독스 놈들이 내 총으로 뭔가 교활한 걸 꾸미려던 모양이야. 여기 자네 보상이네, 받게.
entries.6877096d5299037a1c4b7b2f startedMessageT: 이 일 맡아 줘서 고맙네, 병사. 이 총들이 그만한 값이면 좋겠군!
entries.6877096d5299037a1c4b7b2f successMessageT: 완벽해! 현장에서 아주 잘 쓰일 것 같군! 더 주문해 두겠네, 그리고 자네가 써볼 만한 다른 것도 뭐가 주문되는지 알아보겠어.
entries.68784cf8dbe00560604d51e1 startedMessageT: 늘 그렇듯, 내 시험 대상이 되어 줘서 고맙네.
entries.68784cf8dbe00560604d51e1 successMessageT: 훌륭한 일이었네! 도와준 값으로 조금 더 얹어 주지.
entries.6879a0da60f8d8a90e632755 startedMessageT: 자네를 믿고 있네. 이걸 해내면 후하게 보답하지.
entries.6879a0da60f8d8a90e632755 successMessageT: 좋았어! 여기, 보수로 이걸 받게 — 곧 이 무기들을 배포할 물량을 준비하겠네!
entries.694dc176d149fc1d52000003 successMessageT: 고맙기도 하지, 자네가 우리에게 큰 도움을 줬네. 그러니 여기 큰 총이네. 탄약은 자네가 구해야 할 거야.
entries.687314e1ee500b06711955a2 startedMessageT: 블랙 폰 건물 3층 무기고를 쳐 줘야 한다. 그 도둑놈들이 가져간 것 중 남은 게 있으면 전부 찾아라. 그건 정부 재산이고 우리에게 돌아와야 한다. 문제는 지금 상황이 너무 뜨겁다는 거다. 그러니 프리오제르스크 자연 보호 구역의 USEC 캠프에 있는 검은 SUV에 시제품을 숨겨 둬라. 내 사람들이 회수하면, 수고한 값으로 우리 주둔군이 두둑하게 챙겨 주도록 하겠다.
entries.687314e1ee500b06711955a2 successMessageT: 잘했군 전사. 글루하의 개들이 물건을 옮기기 전에 빼냈어. 우리 조국이 자네에게 신세를 졌네. 여기 자네 몫이다. 이제 사라져라.
entries.6873248b615c003311ebb292 startedMessageT: 바깥에서 행운을 빈다. 이 일로 죽지는 말아라.
entries.6873248b615c003311ebb292 successMessageT: 허, 젠장, 용병, 진짜로 해냈군! 그 콘솔이랑 DVD를 찾았다고? 거창하게 불러주는 넝마주이치고는 나쁘지 않아. 내가 말한 대로 소극장에 갖다 놨지? 내 고객은 좋아서 날아갈 거야, 아마 자기 오래된 팝콘에 눈물이나 흘리고 있겠지. 솜씨가 좀 있군, 대원. 가까이 붙어 있게, 간단한 심부름 하나 망치지 않는 사람이 있다는 건 반가운 일이지. 이제 가서 장비나 손질하든지 해.
entries.686051774a290eb6f216471f successMessageT: 그 수송품을 찾아낸 건 훌륭했네. 그런데 그 무기들이 완전히 쓰레기였더군!! 두 정은 자네가 가져도 되고, 나머지는 그냥 내가 팔아야겠네. 뭐 어쨌든 다시 고맙네.
entries.ff2c2fd5d1e216e8aa91f992 acceptPlayerMes: 어이, 거기 누구야? 아, 내 호텔 방에 쳐들어와도 된다고 생각하는 PMC 하나구먼. 잘 들어라, 이 좆같은 놈아. 난 낯선 놈을 좋게 보지 않으니, 원하는 게 뭐냐? 그 표정을 보니 지금 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 나만큼이나 모르는 것 같군. 그래, 앉아라. 네가 네 얘기를 하기 전에 내가 처한 상황부터 이야기하지.
entries.be3c5ff9d7033690c03b761b successMessageT: 이봐, 자네는 구세주야. PC 앞에 앉아 있을 때 먹기엔 최고의 간식이지. 뭐라도 생기면 알려 주겠네. 아직 생각 중인 게 좀 있어. 고맙네.
entries.67296afd6e3127842d3a2e42 successMessageT: 그놈들이 망할 교훈을 얻었기를 바라네. 또 문제가 생기면 알려 주지.
entries.67296afd6e3127842d3a2e42 completePlayerM: 저들이 그 빌어먹을 교훈을 좀 배웠으면 좋겠군. 또 문제가 생기면 알려 주겠네.
entries.68d99864e574f10eb9d0f773 acceptPlayerMes: 목록은 있나? 그럼 어서 시작해라. 그는 이 물건이 당장 필요하다.
entries.68d99864e574f10eb9d0f773 completePlayerM: 좋다, 이 물건들을 당장 그에게 가져다주지.
entries.68d99864e574f10eb9d0f773 successMessageT: 훌륭하군, 이 물건들을 당장 그에게 전하겠네.
entries.6958b14ffd6eb5da65000001 acceptPlayerMes: 이 덫줄 잃어버리지 말게, 지금은 더 못 구해 주네. 만드는 법을 아는 건 예거뿐일 걸세. 아직도 숲을 돌아다니며 자네 같은 사람들이 걸리도록 그걸 놓고 다니는 그 옛 친구가 있으니 말이야. 그 얘긴 꺼내지도 말게.
entries.6958b14ffd6eb5da65000001 completePlayerM: 정말 고맙다. 이제야 마음 놓고 쉴 수 있을지도.
entries.6958b14ffd6eb5da65000001 successMessageT: 정말 고맙네, 어쩌면 이제야 마음 놓고 쉴 수 있겠군.
entries.fc669d6e8d3ccdbc735fff53 startedMessageT: 삼림이다, 꼬마. 거리를 유지하고 그 두 발을 헛되게 하지 말게. MP-700 이나 Shorty 버전이면 되네. 기다리고 있겠네.
entries.fc669d6e8d3ccdbc735fff53 successMessageT: 소리가 사냥꾼을 만드는 건 아니지. 자네는 그걸 아는 모양이군. 여기 Mammoth 네. 납 탄두가 드러나 있어서 방호구 없는 표적을 겨냥한 거지. 쏠 곳을 잘 골라 두게. 자네 몫으로 재고에 넣어 두겠네.
entries.93fca392a75ac1e0b05cfd10 startedMessageT: 용병들이 자네를 멀리 두게 하지 마라. 가까이 붙고, 때를 골라라. 그리고 재장전할 자리는 남겨 둬라.
entries.93fca392a75ac1e0b05cfd10 successMessageT: 돌아왔군. 용기에 관한 어떤 이야기보다 그게 더 중요하다. Cerberus를 자네 몫으로 따로 둬 두겠다. 근접용으로 쓰고, 그 산탄알이 방탄판 문제를 해결해 줄 거라고는 기대하지 마라.
entries.8bf7e85422290ecae416b1d8 startedMessageT: 타길라, 공장에 있다. MP-700 이나 Shorty 를 가져가게. 방탄복에도 약점은 있다, 꼬마. 그 두 발을 쓰기 전에 머리를 쓰게.
entries.8bf7e85422290ecae416b1d8 successMessageT: 그 여행을 꿈꿨을 때는 가장 고약한 짐승이 바로 여기 있을 거라고는 생각지 못했네. 자네는 그 소총을 다룰 줄 알고, 그게 무엇을 할 수 있고 못 하는지도 알지. 여기 Goliath 탄 몇 발이네. 거래를 충분히 쌓으면 더 대 주겠네. 그것들이 누군가 집에 돌아가는 데 도움이 되길 바라네.
entries.68d3eabc22a258476b064851 successMessageT: 자네가 해낼 줄 알았네! 자네가 그 순위표 맨 아래에서 질질 끌지 않는 게 당연하지.
entries.68d3eb2b2712147eab000f21 successMessageT: 자네가 날 실망시키지 않을 줄 알았지! 자네와 나는 좋은 팀이야, 그렇지?
entries.fd1b683d79e097d49bacc63b startedMessageT: 세관에서 말썽꾼 다섯, 12구경으로. 그리고 레이드에서 가져온 Wilston 두 갑. 끝나면 돌아와라, 그 화물 얘기를 하자.
entries.fd1b683d79e097d49bacc63b successMessageT: 내 애들 말로는 길이 좀 조용해졌다더군. 담배도 신선하고. 좋아. Dan Jackiel 한 병, Tarkovskaya 하나, Wilston 두 갑을 가져오면 5발 탄창 달린 VR80을 하나 가져가도 좋네. 보급마다 하나씩. 내가 얼마나 후한 놈인지 아무에게도 떠벌리지 말게.
entries.35e933725dd8e5e778e3ad71 startedMessageT: 세관에서 스캐브 열 명, VR80으로. 장전이든 부착물이든 자네 마음에 드는 걸로. 그 수입품이 사격장 밖에서 어떤지 한번 보자.
entries.35e933725dd8e5e778e3ad71 successMessageT: 소문이 돌았네. 그 수입품이 제 몫은 하는 모양이군. 공장 사양은 자네 몫으로 계산대에 올려 두겠네. 5발 탄창에 전부 장착된 것, 11만. 술 거래도 그대로 유효하네. 자네가 자네 몫을 계속 하면, 나도 내 몫을 계속 하지.
entries.dd5168501c5131632cca3e2a startedMessageT: 세관에서 스캐브 여덟, PMC는 어디서 찾든 셋. 12게이지, 소음기 장착. 이 일에는 그만의 조건이 있다.
entries.dd5168501c5131632cca3e2a successMessageT: 무슨 일이냐고 문 앞에 몰려드는 사람들이 없군요. 마음에 듭니다. 당신의 VR80 Silent 는 준비됐습니다. Salvo 12, EOTech, AFG, 10발 탄창. Roler 하나, 나무 시계 하나, 금 목걸이 하나, 말 조각상 하나. 한 번 거래에 한 정입니다. 값에는 당신 이름이 이야기에 오르지 않게 해 주는 것까지 포함돼 있습니다.
entries.29c44a1b8bed96c51db5bf78 startedMessageT: 야영지는 요양원 아래 들판을 지나, 격납고와 수송 컨테이너가 있는 곳이다. 손님들을 치워라.
entries.29c44a1b8bed96c51db5bf78 successMessageT: 침투에서 너를 속이지는 않을 것이다, 걱정하지 마라. 준비되면 해안으로 가서 호버크라프트를 찾고, 현금을 가져가라. 그 배에서 다시 빠져나오는 건 네 문제다.

sources.687b616db015c21f329bf45f startedMessageT: Watch your back out there. The woods are crawling with scavs, and they’d love to get their hands on a prize like that. Move quick, stay sharp.
sources.687b616db015c21f329bf45f successMessageT: Impressive work. Let me see it...Clean job. You followed the specs to the letter. I’ve got some extra gear stashed away, good stuff from the reserve. You earned it. Oh, Sergey said you should go by and see him, he's got some new wares you might be interested in.
sources.68561cd4801134be939e11f6 startedMessageT: Hey mercenary. Like I mentioned that accountant’s office should be somewhere in the Black Knight building. Probably up on the top floor. Look for a sign or something marking the door. Keep your eyes sharp.
sources.68561cd4801134be939e11f6 successMessageT: This is going to make a great part of my collection! Crafts like that are hard to come by.
sources.6833b8bc6f8ce71072c4e703 startedMessageT: Get those tags planted and stage the bodies clean. Then disappear. If anyone traces this back or you get caught you’re just a lone wolf acting on your own.
sources.6833b8bc6f8ce71072c4e703 successMessageT: The press is eating it up. Stories about PMC atrocities are everywhere. Geneva’s screaming for blood and our funding’s locked in tight. Nice work Mercenary. Here’s your pay.
sources.6833b8bc6f8ce71072c4e703 failMessageText: You compromised the operation. UNTAR is breathing down my neck. If you can't handle the work, don't take the job.
sources.6833b8bc6f8ce71072c4e703 acceptPlayerMes: This isn’t deception - it’s documenting atrocities they’d commit anyway. Get to Woods.
sources.6833b8bc6f8ce71072c4e703 declinePlayerMe: Not interested? Fine. When UNTAR finally gets pushed out, and the scavs are beating down the door to your hideout? Don't call me begging for help.
sources.6833b8bc6f8ce71072c4e703 completePlayerM: Perfect. If you setup the scene well enough, the world will see the atrocities BEAR and USEC are doing - even if we had to rely on some fabrication.
sources.683645245a1c12488166b1a5 startedMessageT: The vehicle’s parked near Concordia. Watch out for private militia crawling around. Take them out quietly. If that drive’s busted you might as well not come back.
sources.683645245a1c12488166b1a5 successMessageT: Stockholm just coughed up 10000 antibiotic doses and tossed in some spare munitions after I dropped a few hints from the files. Such generous folks they are. Here’s your cut.
sources.683645245a1c12488166b1a5 acceptPlayerMes: Just be sure to get that drive back to me intact. If we play our cards right, this should be a decent payday.
sources.683645245a1c12488166b1a5 declinePlayerMe: Really? You're that scared of some action in the Streets? Didn't take you for a coward.
sources.683645245a1c12488166b1a5 completePlayerM: Another successful op in the books. We make quite the convincing argument for the cause. Check my stores next time you're around - the Swedes sent us some new shiny metal toys to pay for our silence.
sources.686c25d281071c45d2f8aa44 startedMessageT: Move quick and grab that manifest. I need it back here yesterday.
sources.686c25d281071c45d2f8aa44 successMessageT: Well done Mercenary. You pulled through with that manifest. Now I can sort this mess out. Here’s your reward. Expect more work soon.
sources.686dd4f871840e292fbd1a14 startedMessageT: Go get them, make them pay for even thinking they can intercept my gear.
sources.686dd4f871840e292fbd1a14 successMessageT: Good fucking work. I'll be honest, I didn't think you would pull this off. Take this reward for helping me out, I already lost a few of these so what is one more right?
sources.6870170d18b94df2e8700ba0 startedMessageT: Head over and mark those crates so I can get my stuff back. Don’t let me down. Check near the big red building!
sources.6870170d18b94df2e8700ba0 successMessageT: Nice job getting those crates marked. Looks like those Stray Dogs were trying to cook up something slick with my guns. Here’s your reward, take it.
sources.6877096d5299037a1c4b7b2f startedMessageT: Thanks for doing this soldier. These guns better be worth it!
sources.6877096d5299037a1c4b7b2f successMessageT: Perfect! They look like they will do just fine out in the field! I will get more ordered and I will see what else I can get ordered for you to try.
sources.68784cf8dbe00560604d51e1 startedMessageT: As always, thanks again for being my test subject.
sources.68784cf8dbe00560604d51e1 successMessageT: Awesome work! Here is a little extra for your help.
sources.6879a0da60f8d8a90e632755 startedMessageT: I am counting on you. Do this and I will reward you well.
sources.6879a0da60f8d8a90e632755 successMessageT: Hell yeah! Here, take this for payment - I will get a shipment of these weapons ready to distribute soon!
sources.694dc176d149fc1d52000003 successMessageT: Thank fuck, you've done us a huge favor. So here's a huge gun. You'll have to get the ammo though.
sources.687314e1ee500b06711955a2 startedMessageT: I need you to hit the 3rd floor Armory in the Black Pawn building. Find whatever’s left of what those thieves took. That’s government property and it belongs back with us. The issue is that things are a little too hot right now so I will need you to stash the prototype in the black SUV at the USEC Camp over at the Priozersk Nature Reserve. Once my guys retrieve it, my garrison will make sure you get a fat payday for your trouble.
sources.687314e1ee500b06711955a2 successMessageT: Nice work warrior. You pulled those goods out before Glukhar’s dogs could move them. Our homeland owes you one. Here’s your cut. Now get lost.
sources.6873248b615c003311ebb292 startedMessageT: Good Luck out there. Try not to die over this.
sources.6873248b615c003311ebb292 successMessageT: Well, damn, merc, you actually pulled it off! Found that console and dvd, huh? Not bad for a glorified scavenger. Dropped ‘em off at the mini theater like I asked, too? My client’s gonna be over the moon, probably crying into his vintage popcorn. You’ve got some skills, operator. Stick around, nice to have someone that don't fuck up a simple fetch job. Now go clean your gear or something.
sources.686051774a290eb6f216471f startedMessageT: Get your ass out there and find that shipment!
sources.686051774a290eb6f216471f successMessageT: Great work on finding that shipment. Turns out that the weapons were absolute garbage!! You can keep two for yourself and I guess I will just sell the rest. Thanks again I suppose.
sources.ff2c2fd5d1e216e8aa91f992 successMessageT: Fuck yea man. Now we're talkin.
sources.ff2c2fd5d1e216e8aa91f992 acceptPlayerMes: Hey who's there? Oh it's some PMC who thinks he can barge into my hotel room. Well listen here fuckstick, I don't take kindly to strangers so what do you want? That look on your face gives me the idea you know about as much of what's going on as me. Well here, take a seat and we can talk about the situation I'm in before you give your side.
sources.be3c5ff9d7033690c03b761b successMessageT: Dude you're a lifesaver. Best snack ever for sitting at my PC. I'll let you know if anything comes up, I'm still thinking about some things. Thank you.
sources.67296afd6e3127842d3a2e42 successMessageT: Here's hoping they learn their damn lesson. I'll let you know if we have any more issues.
sources.67296afd6e3127842d3a2e42 completePlayerM: Here's hoping they learn their damn lesson. I'll let you know if we have any more issues.
sources.68d99864e574f10eb9d0f773 acceptPlayerMes: You have the list? Well get to it then. He needs this stuff pronto.
sources.68d99864e574f10eb9d0f773 completePlayerM: Excellent, I'll get this stuff to him right away.
sources.68d99864e574f10eb9d0f773 successMessageT: Excellent, I'll get this stuff to him right away.
sources.6958b14ffd6eb5da65000001 acceptPlayerMes: Don't lose these tripwires, I can't get you more at the moment. Jaeger is the only one that knows how to make them I'm pretty sure, given his old friend who still wanders the forests placing them for people like you to run into. Don't even get me started.
sources.6958b14ffd6eb5da65000001 completePlayerM: Thanks a million, maybe I can finally rest easy.
sources.6958b14ffd6eb5da65000001 successMessageT: Thanks a million, maybe I can finally rest easy.
sources.fc669d6e8d3ccdbc735fff53 startedMessageT: Woods, kid. Keep your distance and make those two shots count. The MP-700 or its Shorty version will do. I'll be waiting.
sources.fc669d6e8d3ccdbc735fff53 successMessageT: The noise doesn't make the hunter. Looks like you understand that. Here's the Mammoth: an exposed lead nose, meant for targets without armor. Choose your shot carefully. I'll keep it in stock for you.
sources.93fca392a75ac1e0b05cfd10 startedMessageT: Don't let the mercenaries keep you at arm's length. Get close, pick your moment, and leave yourself somewhere to reload.
sources.93fca392a75ac1e0b05cfd10 successMessageT: You came back. That matters more than any story about bravery. I'll set aside the Cerberus for you. Keep it for close work, and don't expect those pellets to solve the problem of an armor plate.
sources.8bf7e85422290ecae416b1d8 startedMessageT: Tagilla, at the factory. Take the MP-700 or the Shorty. Armor has its weaknesses, kid. Use your head before you use those two cartridges.
sources.8bf7e85422290ecae416b1d8 successMessageT: When I dreamed of that trip, I never thought the worst beasts would be right here. You can handle the rifle, and you know what it can and can't do. Here are a few Goliath cartridges. Once we've done enough business, I'll supply you with more. I hope they help someone get home.
sources.68d3eabc22a258476b064851 successMessageT: I knew you'd handle it! No wonder you're not dragging along at the very bottom of those lists.
sources.68d3eb2b2712147eab000f21 successMessageT: I knew you wouldn't let me down! You and I make a great team, right?
sources.fd1b683d79e097d49bacc63b startedMessageT: Five troublemakers at Customs, with a twelve-gauge. And two packs of Wilston from a raid. Come back when it's done and we'll talk about that shipment.
sources.fd1b683d79e097d49bacc63b successMessageT: My boys say the road's a bit quieter. And the smokes are fresh. Good. Bring a bottle of Dan Jackiel, one Tarkovskaya, and two packs of Wilston, and you can take a VR80 with the five-round mag. One per shipment. Don't go telling everyone what a generous bastard I am.
sources.35e933725dd8e5e778e3ad71 startedMessageT: Ten Scavs at Customs, with the VR80. Any load or attachments you like. Let's see what that import does outside a shooting range.
sources.35e933725dd8e5e778e3ad71 successMessageT: Word got around. Looks like the import can work for a living. I'll keep the factory build on the counter for you: five-round mag, everything fitted, a hundred and ten thousand. The bottle deal stays on the table too. You keep doing your part, I'll keep doing mine.
sources.dd5168501c5131632cca3e2a startedMessageT: Eight Scavs at Customs, three PMCs wherever you find them. Twelve-gauge, suppressor fitted. This job has its own terms.
sources.dd5168501c5131632cca3e2a successMessageT: No crowd at my door asking what happened. I like that. Your VR80 Silent is ready: Salvo 12, EOTech, AFG, ten-round mag. One Roler, a wooden clock, a gold chain, and a horse figurine. One build per shipment. The price includes me keeping your name out of the conversation.
sources.29c44a1b8bed96c51db5bf78 startedMessageT: The camp sits past the field below the resort, hangars and shipping containers. Clear the guests out.
sources.29c44a1b8bed96c51db5bf78 successMessageT: They will not screw you on the insertion, do not worry. When you are ready, head to the shore, find the hovercraft, and bring cash. Getting back off that ship is your own problem.
sources.29c44a1b8bed96c51db5bf78 failMessageText: The camp is still crawling with guests. Smugglers won't talk to you like this.
sources.e857e9c34949ecbf1cf5a5b2 startedMessageT: Thin them out wherever you find them. The smugglers will hear about it.
sources.e857e9c34949ecbf1cf5a5b2 successMessageT: That's a dent in them, alright. I'll pass the word along, they should be a lot more talkative now.
sources.e857e9c34949ecbf1cf5a5b2 failMessageText: The Rogues are still all over them. Nobody's rearranging anything for you yet.
sources.8b2b4eea617e2be2e54df123 startedMessageT: Walk it yourself, start to finish. Strobes on both ends so they know it was actually checked.
sources.8b2b4eea617e2be2e54df123 successMessageT: Route's logged. The guys can move on their commander now, and they'll remember who cleared it for them.
sources.8b2b4eea617e2be2e54df123 failMessageText: Route's still a blank spot. Nobody's moving on anything.
sources.c7a1f0b93e64d5827ab1cc40 successMessageT: That's a decent haul of grub you brought. With stuff like this, the conversation will go a lot easier. By the next time we meet, I should have something for you about your request.
sources.c7a1f0b93e64d5827ab1cc40 failMessageText: I'm showing up empty-handed then. Thanks for nothing.
sources.3f8d2c5a9b17e04d6ca8f312 startedMessageT: Come find me when you want to hear it.
sources.3f8d2c5a9b17e04d6ca8f312 successMessageT: The smugglers are ready to help you, and you did right by them, so they're cutting you a deal. Half price on the crossing, 250 grand instead of the usual 500. Just have the cash on you when you head out, alright?
sources.3f8d2c5a9b17e04d6ca8f312 failMessageText: Suit yourself. The offer was on the table.
sources.ff56532d9100ce03006493e9 startedMessageT: The tower relay is dead. A toolset and steady hands, that's all it takes to get us listening.
sources.ff56532d9100ce03006493e9 successMessageT: You did everything correctly. I already managed to intercept another transmission. Nothing great, if I'm honest. The crew was talking to Knight, the Rogues commander. Most likely they want to take whatever is useful from the ship. Or they know something we don't. Either way, we need to move fast. Let's do it this way: I'll dig for information online, you work on the ground.
sources.ff56532d9100ce03006493e9 failMessageText: The relay is still dead. Without it we're deaf.
sources.07c1ecde2c4652876fc769b1 startedMessageT: The railway station, beyond the water treatment plant. The hangar is what you want. Leave the containers alone.
sources.07c1ecde2c4652876fc769b1 successMessageT: Let me guess. "Boreas"? Yeah, I found something too. The thing is, "Boreas" never reached the port. It was blocked outside Tarkov when the TerraGroup scandal started, and the ship and crew have stayed trapped in the blockade this whole time. It could've stayed there much longer. It's an icebreaker, and not an ordinary one. I reviewed its procurement history and known routes. "Boreas" spent most of its time either on autonomous Arctic expeditions or traveling between northern ports. Icebreakers are usually used to open routes along the Northern Sea Route, and TerraGroup has offices in all those ports. But there's zero information about those expeditions or their purpose. Nothing at all.
sources.9d5e3f7d6320a7fd139a2772 startedMessageT: Two problems to solve. Getting out there, and getting back. Do not go anywhere near that ship until you have both.
sources.9d5e3f7d6320a7fd139a2772 successMessageT: Excellent. I've identified the icebreaker's coordinates, but I haven't intercepted any more transmissions. Most likely the Rogues are already on their way to "Boreas". And remember, this icebreaker could be an important TerraGroup asset. That means it's likely well defended. Good luck.
sources.9d5e3f7d6320a7fd139a2772 failMessageText: Without transport arranged, that ship may as well be on the moon.
sources.6a7e0916b881de241018539d startedMessageT: Ten of them, my friend, and five tags taken off the bodies yourself. I will know the difference.
sources.6a7e0916b881de241018539d successMessageT:
Let me see. Yes, these will do. My analysts will have names by the end of the week, or numbers at least.

As promised, the container is now surplus stock. Come to me when you need equipment, and bring tags. The paperwork is easier that way.
sources.6a7e0916b881de241018539d failMessageText: No tags, no report, and the container stays exactly where it is. A pity, my friend. We could both have done well out of this.
sources.6aa83f652bec3212bf930001 successMessageT:
You have the logbook? I trust you avoided drawing attention on your way back. I will arrange your reward through my associates.

One more thing: I strongly advise against returning to the Icebreaker. According to my sources, it has already come under the control of some special unit. You would not survive an engagement with them.
sources.6aa83f652bec3212bf930002 successMessageT: It seems Mechanic’s device is functioning properly. I hope you managed to avoid contact with the special unit I warned you about. My recommendation remains the same: if you want to survive, it would be best not to return to that site.
sources.87a7b372472f4eefa4a5240a startedMessageT: Three military power filters, fresh from the field. No filters, no rotors.
sources.87a7b372472f4eefa4a5240a successMessageT: Hand them over to my guys on the way out. So now you want to talk about the helicopter? Alright, we can talk. First, it needs maintenance. And no, I'm not letting you anywhere near a machine like that. What, you want me to send you a beer to your hideout so you don't get bored? No chance, rookie!
sources.87a7b372472f4eefa4a5240a failMessageText: No filters, no helicopter. Simple arithmetic.
sources.6ae67821fba98a599d75d6b6 startedMessageT: AMG-10, Reserve base. Canisters or special containers. Don't come back with engine oil, rookie.
sources.6ae67821fba98a599d75d6b6 successMessageT: Ah, it's you. Leave it by the entrance. I'll have the boys prep the bird. When do we fly? Here's the situation... I talked to the pilots. I'll be straight with you: they're not flying to some unknown ship. You'll get the chopper, but only for extraction from the ship. To get in, you'll have to figure something else out. Too risky. There's no telling who's dug in on that ship. I could lose the bird, crew included. And I don't have spare pilots. So, you taking the heli or not? Then listen up. The chopper can only pick you up from a proper landing zone. Hope your ship's got one. Clear it, pop a signal flare, and the bird will come in. One more thing. Don't forget to bring cash. Every flight costs money.
sources.6ae67821fba98a599d75d6b6 failMessageText: No oil, no maintenance. No maintenance, no helicopter.
sources.6a75661b478c184bd220c433 startedMessageT: Five cans, soldier. Helipad and the storage areas, that is where they will be.
sources.6a75661b478c184bd220c433 successMessageT: Alright, you handled that job well. I'll give you that. Maybe things between us will keep going smooth, just don't forget your reputation and don't even think about screwing me over. You're dismissed for now, soldier.
sources.6a75661b478c184bd220c433 failMessageText: No fluid, no maintenance. My bird stays grounded, and that is on you.
sources.6a753b58478c184bd220c417 startedMessageT: Ten packs, and the dosage must be the high one. Please be discreet about where you are looking.
sources.6a753b58478c184bd220c417 successMessageT: Where did you manage to obtain so many? I was not even expecting five packs... The Icebreaker? Such a find could be extremely important for supporting our work. I need to check something in the department, and then I will return to you with a new task. We cannot afford to miss an opportunity of this value.
sources.6a753b58478c184bd220c417 failMessageText: The order was not filled. I will have to plan around the shortage, as always.
sources.6a753cf3478c184bd220c426 startedMessageT: Three analyzers, and they must be intact. Check the medical section of the ship first.
sources.6a753cf3478c184bd220c426 successMessageT: You found the Aceso? That is probably the best news of the day. Given the shortages in Tarkov, they will be a very valuable asset... But of course, I will only consider parting with them in cases of extreme necessity. For now, they will go straight into operation and greatly ease the workload of my staff and patients.
sources.6a753cf3478c184bd220c426 failMessageText: No analyzers, then. My department will continue as it has been.
sources.695c99f4138ce4c3ccb622ef acceptPlayerMes: Oh, and I can't risk my own peacekeepers for this mission. Might cause an international conflict if we got involved. You're plenty capable on your own though.
sources.695c99f4138ce4c3ccb622ef successMessageT: Seems like that did the trick. My guys haven't ran into any Russian patrols since I sent you out, so here's your reward.
sources.695c9bb87f63551bef72cecb acceptPlayerMes: Remember, make a point. Target the experienced ones.
sources.695c9bb87f63551bef72cecb successMessageT: You're back? They're making a mess of their frequencies, good job. What? Of course we have their radio encryption keys. You think I'm running this operation blind?
sources.695c96ccf3389a5ab3f594e6 successMessageT: Perfect, the routes are running unbothered now! Here's what I promised, hopefully it makes up for Prapor being on your ass.
sources.695c96ccf3389a5ab3f594e6 acceptPlayerMes: Great, show those assholes money flows my way, not theirs.
sources.695c96ccf3389a5ab3f594e6 completePlayerM: Perfect, the routes are running unbothered now! Here's what I promised, hopefully it makes up for Prapor being on your ass.
sources.69085a524e8082229957904c successMessageT: Interesting... But do you think I need your money? This makes me curious... Are you just someone with a lot of money who doesn't care how they spend it, or are you so determined to have this contact?
sources.6908cc9eba0a887c798e1f11 successMessageT: Information is the most valuable thing nowadays. You did a good job. Here is your reward... you will need it.
sources.6908e22349d63fbaf2dd3b9a successMessageT: Good work. Keep it up, and you will be properly rewarded.
sources.690a2def6c4ba5b7f1e9457d acceptPlayerMes:
This TerraGroup complex is an area of great interest, and I already have access to the cameras that cover all of Ground Zero, except for two blind spots.

There is a building next to the complex with a good view. Install it near the window where an NSV Utyos machine gun was installed. 

For the second camera... Have you ever had coffee at Coffee Maniac? They say it's great, so maybe behind it near the debris that was left there.
sources.690a2def6c4ba5b7f1e9457d successMessageT: Thank you for your performance on the mission. Keep it up, and you will have a promising future by my side.
sources.6a4de4da46604165ad7d0ce1 successMessageT: What was I thinking, assuming you'd actually be useful.
sources.6a4de6851d3fc0503f000c17 successMessageT: Great! Let's get on with the work.
sources.690a553efc51c1efb8c22ded acceptPlayerMes: My next operation will be crucial. Customs has been a turbulent environment, so you will recon the area and get out in one piece. You will have new tasks to do.
sources.690a659d592d4e5a142036bb acceptPlayerMes: My team is already doing the hard work on Customs, but these Scavs are annoying; they cause trouble, so ensure they have the necessary support.
sources.690a659d592d4e5a142036bb successMessageT: Thank you. We are moving towards something better.
sources.690ad6e0f4aac3c28195d97c acceptPlayerMes:
Hello again. You've been doing well so far, and I need you to keep it up. 

Intelligence informed me that other high-relevance traders are sending out contracts for Scav eliminations on Customs. Remember Jaeger? He will be the first, so accept his contract and do it.
sources.690ad6e0f4aac3c28195d97c successMessageT: Exceptional performance so far. We are close to concluding everything for a bigger step.
sources.690adfb8b6469342b3cbfabc acceptPlayerMes: Hello, mercenary. Final phase of the operation. I need you to collect some specific equipment for my team; you can find it with Reshala's guards on Customs. These items will play a fundamental role in the next steps.
sources.690adfb8b6469342b3cbfabc successMessageT: Thank you. I am very satisfied with your performance so far. Await new instructions.
sources.690af2bed4521bca8e6a2fb9 acceptPlayerMes:
Do you know what the ISB is? The USEC Intelligence Support Bureau. For a long time, this was a secret division. After Blue Fire, it became a three-front conflict: Bears, USECs, and Scavs. Our role was always behind the scenes, until the day a fourth player wanted to get involved...

TerraGroup is not worth all the blood and suffering this land has witnessed, and this must end. If you think you can be a part of it, you will demonstrate it now with a huge sacrifice. 

Good luck.
sources.690af2bed4521bca8e6a2fb9 successMessageT: Perfect! I knew we could count on you. Welcome to hell.
sources.690af7eaf5a597ebc0b602f6 successMessageT: Perfect! I knew we could count on you. Welcome to hell.
sources.6910218dea9506c0857ab999 successMessageT:
Welcome to the team. You may not have realized the objective of everything we've done so far, but it's quite simple. Did you know Reshala has a kind of association? A syndicate. One of my agents is already infiltrated and close enough to assume high-level positions, and that's why you are going to eliminate ONE single Guard of his, and he will be replaced by one of ours.

It is of extreme importance that you do not eliminate Reshala or any other of his Guards. We will focus all intelligence to ensure more men get close to him. Good luck!
sources.6912aa3f56e36f28b556c7f4 acceptPlayerMes:
You are too green for special operations. Regardless, every ISB agent specializes in handling almost every type of Western weaponry; after all, that is what we work with here. 

During your time in Tarkov, you must have utilized many different weapons. We cannot risk you getting rusty, so it is time for new training. If you perform well, I guarantee you will have a suitable reward.
sources.6912aa3f56e36f28b556c7f4 successMessageT: Expected... you did well regardless. Await your new test.
sources.6912c61d527bc3f9790b5776 acceptPlayerMes: It is time to continue practicing, and obviously, our expectations of you are increasing. You need to keep training with Western weapons if you wish to reach an exemplary standard. We are counting on you.
sources.6912c61d527bc3f9790b5776 successMessageT: Great, better than I expected. As promised, I will grant you some privileges in purchasing equipment.
sources.6912c8df72a190f1caae8298 acceptPlayerMes:
Half the path has been walked; I hope it is being minimally entertaining. Actually, I don't. 

Your performance has been notable and quite impressive, and we hope you continue developing to become an excellent agent.
sources.6912c8df72a190f1caae8298 successMessageT: You actually know how to shoot. I am trying to avoid being impressed, but I cannot deny that you have been a good addition to the team.
sources.6912cbdcf7e36ec0ee1de240 acceptPlayerMes:
How did you make it this far? I hope it isn't becoming tiresome to use these beautiful weapons, because for someone to think that would be OFFENSIVE to me. 

Regardless, you are doing very well, and I hope you are also satisfied with the rewards.
sources.6912ceca14c4d7453878e335 acceptPlayerMes:
When you and Jaeger were digging for information about us, I thought you would be just another couple of poor souls we would have to make disappear. I confess I am relieved I didn't have to make that decision, and that is why I am also proud to say that this is your final test. 

Good luck.
sources.6912ceca14c4d7453878e335 successMessageT: Incredible! You really have a knack for this type of equipment, and I couldn't be prouder.
sources.6913af3e41d70209e1c9dc13 acceptPlayerMes: I love the Five-seveN, so we will start with it. I'm going to give you a sequence of tasks so you can prove your skill with several different weapons normally used by our team. Exciting, isn't it? So let's start with this beautiful weapon, so good it was banned in several places, but obviously, not for us.
sources.6913af3e41d70209e1c9dc13 successMessageT: Great! A difficult task for a pistol, but you executed it very well.
sources.6913fe5afc7a709d1e0aeba6 acceptPlayerMes: The beautiful P90. It was manufactured by FN Herstal, the same manufacturer as the Five-seveN. Powerful caliber and surprising fire rate, making it worthy of a challenge to match.
sources.6913fe5afc7a709d1e0aeba6 successMessageT: You actually did well with a submachine gun. Keep it up.
sources.69141e39dc0b928717fdd14b acceptPlayerMes: I'm not such a fan of SIG Sauer weapons, with the exception of their pistols, but the AR configuration makes many adore this submachine gun, so it will be part of the test. Have a nice trip to Customs.
sources.69141e39dc0b928717fdd14b successMessageT: I expected nothing less; you really look like someone who masters the AR configuration.
sources.69142292070bcc615773f970 acceptPlayerMes: We have finally arrived at one of my favorite weapons, and of course, I couldn't leave you with an easy challenge. Heckler & Koch is quite a manufacturer; a submachine gun with so much firepower. You will manage to complete the challenge easily.
sources.69142292070bcc615773f970 successMessageT: Perfect! I hope you had fun; I love an MP7!
sources.6914f92790fe68c14629e795 acceptPlayerMes: Look at Heckler & Koch again. Let's change the weapon type a bit and start with DMRs. My people use them quite a lot during missions—the standard procedure: some stay back protecting the team from afar while others advance. Higher fire rate, more control and precision. I hope you enjoy DMRs.
sources.6914f92790fe68c14629e795 successMessageT: Expected, but it still deserves congratulations.
sources.6914eaa069904863f3247ecd acceptPlayerMes: Another high-standard DMR. Perfect stability and an impressive fire rate, besides having a resemblance to the AR configuration as well. I just handed you some good things, so it's time to put them into action.
sources.6914eaa069904863f3247ecd successMessageT: You did well! I think I could have made it harder, ah, no need for that.
sources.69150a9cc13d182f8d1e6636 acceptPlayerMes: You have come quite far, that is great! Now let's raise the bar a bit. Have you ever operated with a .338 caliber weapon? It is incredible, powerful, and very unique, which is why I am willing to give you some very interesting rewards if you complete this challenge. Good luck!
sources.69150a9cc13d182f8d1e6636 successMessageT: Nice! Thrilling, isn't it? You are doing very well.
sources.691509a8317f46ac275c10c4 acceptPlayerMes: We have reached the Sniper Rifles. My people rely heavily on precision, patience, and calm, so this time I want to demand a little more accuracy from you. I am sure you are capable.
sources.691509a8317f46ac275c10c4 successMessageT: You are good with a Sniper! Perhaps you would make a good marksman on the team.
sources.691514d147e21d507ab4c72f acceptPlayerMes:
Remember what we discussed about the .338 caliber? There is a Sniper Rifle of this same caliber. Every time I needed to utilize it, it was during missions in Labs, using it like a carbine. It is not safe and I don't recommend it, but I admit it is very fun. 

Just like with the Mk-18, I will demand a complex challenge, but I guarantee you will be rewarded for it. Good luck!
sources.691514d147e21d507ab4c72f successMessageT: Hahaha, I love this weapon! It was exciting to see your results progressing. Congratulations!
sources.69151f4a0c51debb169cc953 acceptPlayerMes: Assault Rifles are the main weapons we utilize here, and honestly, the MDR 5.56x45mm is my favorite; that multi-colored design makes it look even better. Anyway, handling a weapon like this is easy, and we hope you achieve many kills with it. Good luck!
sources.69151f4a0c51debb169cc953 successMessageT: You did well! Since it is my favorite weapon, I will give you some items to enjoy, and of course, I hope you like the customization.
sources.69153dcab3aae4e9422e48a0 acceptPlayerMes: A powerful caliber for an automatic weapon. We expect you to also demonstrate high performance by eliminating some heavily armored bosses. This way, we can thoroughly test both your efficiency and that of the weapon.
sources.69153dcab3aae4e9422e48a0 successMessageT: It seems the two brothers were no match for you. You did very well!
sources.691526e16db665e1712d6246 acceptPlayerMes: I love the HK 416A5, but I recently replaced it with the Radian Weapons Model 1 FA. I hope one day that weapon makes its way to Tarkov. Regardless, this is one of the most used weapons by our team—powerful, high fire rate, and precise—so I will also ask for a more complex challenge. Good luck!
sources.691526e16db665e1712d6246 successMessageT: Wonderful! It's not a Model 1, but it is an incredible weapon.
sources.6960292c08a0653253dcd002 successMessageT: Excellent work! The Model 1 FA has a different feel to it, wouldn't you agree?
sources.6960292c08a0653253dcd002 acceptPlayerMes: While I was putting together some HKs for my crew, I heard that some Model 1 FAs have started showing up in Tarkov. It's a pretty rare find right now, so I wish you luck getting your hands on one to finish this task. But I'll tell you this: if you manage to do it, I'll make sure you're properly rewarded with one of our unique Model 1 variants. Who knows, maybe one day I'll even let you buy that model directly from me...
sources.691551f21744ab25e3e9ff77 acceptPlayerMes: One of our Special Forces members is completely fascinated by this weapon. I see value, but not *that* much. Regardless, I acknowledge that many operators view the MCX-SPEAR as the most powerful weapon, and therefore, this will likely be the greatest challenge you will face. But considering you will have better access to Hybrid ammunition, who is going to stop you after this, right?
sources.691551f21744ab25e3e9ff77 successMessageT: You did it; you completed all the challenges involving the weapons, and I couldn't be prouder. Congratulations on this!
sources.69156abce46a469364c4a8ff acceptPlayerMes: To be an established member of the ISB, good medical knowledge and physical preparation are necessary. Let's start by improving your capabilities
sources.69156abce46a469364c4a8ff successMessageT: For the first task, you did well.
sources.69156f0aaf9e9c284214e0db acceptPlayerMes: You collected some items, so let's continue at this same pace and also practice using medications. I await your news!
sources.69156f0aaf9e9c284214e0db successMessageT: You did well; you are evolving quite a bit around here.
sources.69157484c8721ef63f2ecd6d acceptPlayerMes: Your physical fitness is also very important. Furthermore, some treatments need to be done quickly and emergently during combat. You will collect some of these items and continue practicing the use of medications.
sources.69157484c8721ef63f2ecd6d successMessageT: Great, you are not disappointing, and I hope you keep it up.
sources.6915f6edfd13e8f758865cb6 acceptPlayerMes: The ability to withstand pain on the battlefield is very valuable, and of course we use many painkillers to facilitate all of this. Whether they are injectors or pills, what you can use fastest to continue the fight is the most valuable thing. Let's continue the training.
sources.6915f6edfd13e8f758865cb6 successMessageT: Impressive. We are getting close to the end.
sources.691749d56952436319da14c4 acceptPlayerMes: We often suffer serious enough injuries that can only be resolved with deep surgery. I admit that at first I thought performing surgery on yourself during a battle was the most insane thing possible, but unfortunately, it became common. Let's practice that.
sources.691749d56952436319da14c4 successMessageT: You learn quickly, but let's make it a little harder...
sources.6917555e3dc047dac768f90a acceptPlayerMes: You seem to have learned how to use the CMS Kits well, but you must have realized that they are very improvised, and that doesn't result in quality surgery. That's why you will now use the Surv12. I await your return.
sources.6917555e3dc047dac768f90a successMessageT: You would actually make a good combat medic; well done.
sources.6917c69ad2e7971e1ca792c1 acceptPlayerMes: Injectors. I hope you're not afraid of needles. TerraGroup and other manufacturers have created various types of injectors that can help you get out of complicated situations in combat or even outside of it. Some are very valuable in fights, so you will learn to identify them and, of course, use them. Good luck!
sources.6917c69ad2e7971e1ca792c1 successMessageT: Perfect, you completed all tests without showing any difficulty, I'm proud!
sources.6a6a30b9ba24bd7648105576 successMessageT:
"They fight to feed these flames
We'll set the past on fire
And rise from the ashes higher
We are empire"
sources.6917f4864286e5bd06fc451d acceptPlayerMes: Being in the ISB requires not only skill and knowledge but demonstrating the highest level of both. Our academy is not easy, and I won't judge you if you don't even want to try, but if you manage to go through everything, you deserve a valuable reward in addition to my... respect. I hope you succeed.
sources.6917f4864286e5bd06fc451d successMessageT: You not only mastered the body, the mind, and the equipment. You did it all with great dexterity and determination, which is already very valuable, and honestly, it's difficult to earn my respect, and you definitely succeeded. Congratulations!
sources.6927c77a68a96ac088d64954 acceptPlayerMes:
In here, we have an interesting workflow when it comes to weapons. Our field agents eventually neutralize BEAR and RUAF agents, it happens... Anyway, we have a habit of investigating and understanding the enemy's equipment, so our engineering team disassembles the weapons, identifies the parts individually, and makes a list. We then send it to Tier 2 to assemble them so we can confirm the configuration. 

Since most of our Tier 2 personnel are busy, you'll be in charge of this task. To be fair, since you're assembling non-Western weapons, I'll pay you in Roubles. I heard Mechanic has already asked you to build some weapons; it's similar. Since I'm in a great mood, I'll disassemble one of my Glocks and send you the list just like the engineering team does, so you can get used to it, okay?
sources.692a6a8bfe6ebf8a133bea5e acceptPlayerMes: Now that you've partially understood, let's start with the real work. We've acquired a very simple PP-19-01, but even simple ones need to have their manufacturing and model precisely recorded. We're counting on you.
sources.692a6a8bfe6ebf8a133bea5e successMessageT: You're doing well, keep it up.
sources.692a6e6ad008d27306f38d5c acceptPlayerMes: We recently picked up an interesting AKM. Reduced magazine, visually restored. I confess I didn't find it very efficient, but some engineers here are interested in building its blueprint, so we'll leave it in your hands again.
sources.692a6e6ad008d27306f38d5c successMessageT: Well done, I appreciate your performance.
sources.692a796ed1317f01a0d461e1 acceptPlayerMes: We recently detained a BEAR operator who was armed with a very interesting STM-9 Gen.2 9x19 carbine. It has many cool modifications for a semi-automatic weapon of such a small caliber. Our team rebuilt the gun, but they got busy with another task and told me it's missing just one part to be 100% ready. From my experience, it's something involving the stock or the tube. Good luck finding out!
sources.692a796ed1317f01a0d461e1 successMessageT: You're smart. I like what I see!
sources.692d248d323b786edd54307e acceptPlayerMes: 9x39mm caliber rifles are very interesting and are barely used by NATO or Western forces. We have a new request from the engineers for a KBP VSK-94. Good luck!
sources.692d248d323b786edd54307e successMessageT: Satisfactory performance. Take this, you deserve it.
sources.692d2b4e5f3b1677b9c04834 acceptPlayerMes:
We've received information that a group of BEARs collaborated with some Scavs to mass-produce SV-98s adapted for long-range combat with high precision. It's a cheap setup, but if we have the opportunity to ruin their plan, we'll take it. I need you to build an SV-98 bolt-action sniper rifle with the worst possible configuration; anything you want to take off or put on is fine. We just need it to have three things. 
- 10-round capacity magazine 
- Leapers UTG 25mm ring scope mount 
- VOMZ Pilad 4x32 25.4mm riflescope
sources.692d2b4e5f3b1677b9c04834 successMessageT: Great, let's continue with the plan!
sources.692d310cbdf122e5296a2c12 acceptPlayerMes: Our intelligence reported that a Scav left the original plans for the rifle on top of the building known as 'Queen' in Reserve. Your goal is to retrieve the original plans and replace them with these from the weapon you built. Additionally, I need you to leave a message to be convincing, so eliminate anyone with that terrible gun you made. We're counting on you.
sources.692d310cbdf122e5296a2c12 successMessageT: You've been a good addition to our team; I'm getting excited about where this is headed.
sources.692dd0b1cda5a668af01ce3f acceptPlayerMes: We almost never go near Interchange, but recently Killa's movements caught our attention. He's famous for his RPK and heavily armored gear, so we want to test if our own RPK is a match for him. I'll forward you the blueprint.
sources.692dd0b1cda5a668af01ce3f successMessageT: You finished off Killa that easily? Well, I guess that was unexpected, but congratulations.
sources.692e70c70f46140eb149e9b0 acceptPlayerMes: Since your last task, I really liked that GL-Shock stock, so I asked my people to work with it on a new project. We've noticed an increase in PMCs near our command post here on Lighthouse using AK-12 rifles, so they set up a project to test it. But please, test it far from here because I really can't stand hearing the sound of that gun anymore.
sources.692e70c70f46140eb149e9b0 successMessageT: Good job; having one less AK-12 firing around here is already a victory for me.
sources.692e773e3b10698b80de19dd acceptPlayerMes: Ever met Kaban? Don't worry, I won't send you to Streets of Tarkov, but during some reconnaissance, we noticed that some of his personal bodyguards use SAG AK-545 carbines. By default, it's an interesting gun, so we gathered some info to build one—or rather, for you to build one.
sources.692e773e3b10698b80de19dd successMessageT: Great! Who knows, maybe one day I'll have you test it there in Streets of Tarkov.
sources.692e891b499e7bf623c9a0d7 acceptPlayerMes: Occasionally, we have a concern with Snipers, and although we have our own marksmen, knowing that you could be hit at any moment by someone you have no idea where they are is terrifying. We recently captured a USEC operator nearby who was giving our people a hard time. He was armed with a DVL-10 sniper rifle, which is becoming quite common in Tarkov according to our records. The team cataloged his weapon's configuration, and now it's up to you.
sources.692e891b499e7bf623c9a0d7 successMessageT: You're a good sniper; I didn't expect that. Good job!
sources.69350f8110244587c320fcc3 acceptPlayerMes: Recently, some of our agents were ambushed by those Raider scum on Reserve. Fortunately, we had no casualties, and unfortunately, neither did they. But during the confrontation, one of them ended up leaving a weapon behind—an AS VAL, which is quite unusual for Raider equipment. We have a new project for you to handle.
sources.69350f8110244587c320fcc3 successMessageT: They say the AS VAL is quite different from most weapons, but clearly, that wasn't a problem for you. Great!
sources.693519f2c89a1eeb05ec90dc acceptPlayerMes:
Recently, our special operations group raided a hideout on Shoreline and unexpectedly found it completely empty. However, the investigation indicated that whoever was using the hideout left in a hurry—likely tipped off or noticing our team's movements. 

The important part is that our people found an SR-1MP pistol. That in itself isn't a problem, but the configuration they noted is very commonly used by Federal Security Service (FSB) agents. If they are involved alongside the RUAF, we'll be in trouble soon. Confirm the pistol project and let's move on.
sources.693519f2c89a1eeb05ec90dc successMessageT: Simple project, right? I hope it served as a break, as we have a lot of work to do.
sources.69351fe6f2a1ecd7e63f6e56 acceptPlayerMes:
We've confirmed the previous information. A high-level informant reported that some FSB agents performed reconnaissance in several areas of Tarkov, but we couldn't confirm exactly what they are looking for. Regardless, we need to record everything about them, especially their equipment. 

The most common weapon is the SR-2M 'Veresk' 9x21 submachine gun, which was designed at the direct request of the Federal Protective Service (FSO) and the Federal Security Service (FSB), and therefore is frequently seen with Russian special ops teams. Your mission is to deliver some samples to us. We need one SR-2M 'Veresk' in the FSB configuration and one SR-2M 'Veresk' in the TAC configuration. Good luck!
sources.69351fe6f2a1ecd7e63f6e56 successMessageT: Excellent, these specimens will be vital for our analysis.
sources.6935ab7b4bc7b94f846f07f7 acceptPlayerMes: My engineers showed me a project that, I confess, I had to hold back from laughing at in front of everyone. It's a VSS Vintorez special sniper rifle but with a long-range Sniper configuration that I can't even imagine working. Unfortunately, I'm too busy to build the weapon myself, so do me a favor and assemble it for me. I can't wait to see this.
sources.6935ab7b4bc7b94f846f07f7 successMessageT: What on earth is this? I can't even imagine someone using a weapon like this as a DMR. Thank you for showing me.
sources.6935b1eef317678182e816a2 acceptPlayerMes: We acquired an Kalashnikov AKM 7.62x39 assault rifle with a very powerful configuration, and it caught my interest. Our staff has already set up the weapon's blueprint, and now we're counting on you to assemble it.
sources.6935b1eef317678182e816a2 successMessageT: Well done. Although the suppressor could be changed, it's a beautiful weapon.
sources.6935b53d3e8600e7f38ae82f acceptPlayerMes: One of our agents was passing through Factory and ended up neutralizing a Scav who had a very strange IWI UZI. This model doesn't have a very high rate of fire anyway, so WHY A 100-ROUND MAGAZINE? I can't understand it, but it's good to record it to avoid problems in the future.
sources.6935b53d3e8600e7f38ae82f successMessageT: A strange weapon, but what matters is that you completed the task well. Thank you.
sources.693622dadbceda0ed3ce9b86 acceptPlayerMes: Remember the problem with Snipers? Recently, we had another similar issue, but this time it was a BEAR with a heavily modified SV-98 bolt-action sniper rifle. He was taken down by one of our marksmen, and obviously, we've already collected the gear. You need to finalize our project for the weapon once again.
sources.693622dadbceda0ed3ce9b86 successMessageT: Thank you for the effort. You assembled everything very well.
sources.6936559e123339477ce19f4f acceptPlayerMes: Worrying situation... We had a direct confrontation with an FSB unit near the WTP on Lighthouse; at least the Rogues still have some consideration for us and helped in the fight. Losses on both sides, and the only thing we got from them was some gear and a modified SR-3M. These weapons are quite hard to come by, so let's catalog everything and set up the project.
sources.6936559e123339477ce19f4f successMessageT: Well done; having such a special piece of equipment on the list is very good.
sources.6936586cb6fd4a7c0c4575c2 acceptPlayerMes: My people passed through Reserve and took heavy fire from Glukhar and his team. That ASh-12 and that caliber are devastating, and we're looking for sweet revenge. We couldn't find an ASh-12 anywhere to create a blueprint, so we had to buy a project and we're leaving the assembly to you.
sources.6936586cb6fd4a7c0c4575c2 successMessageT: You're making it less likely that I'll regret adding you to the team. Great work!
sources.6936612433e457ba05d926d8 acceptPlayerMes: The SVDS 7.62x54 sniper rifle is likely the most dangerous of the DMRs, primarily due to its very powerful caliber. We recently bought a high-standard SVD project and need a specimen; since it's a more expensive weapon with very specific modifications, I will consider this your last weapon-building task. Thank you for all your effort so far.
sources.6936612433e457ba05d926d8 successMessageT: Surprising. I have no words to thank you for all your effort so far; you've greatly advanced our counter-intelligence operations regarding enemy equipment. Thank you!
sources.694bf7616e308ab55b47cef6 acceptPlayerMes: Hello, mercenary. We are making some headway into Shoreline—after all, it’s close to the port currently being used as an evacuation point. Our intelligence has intercepted some concerning details about the situation there, which we’ll share as soon as we can. Anyway, we need to do a little 'cleanup' in the area to move forward with our operations. We’re counting on you.
sources.694bf7616e308ab55b47cef6 successMessageT: You certainly know how to shoot. Acceptable performance.
sources.694bfb731131e30433a6d95f acceptPlayerMes: Recently, we’ve been working with some UN officers from the mission in Tarkov—UNTAR. Honestly, collaborating with them is always a headache. No matter how much chaos is breaking loose, they’re always breathing down our necks, yet it seems other groups don't get the same treatment... funny how that works. Regardless, since we’re already in Shoreline, we need to deliver some supplies.
sources.694bfb731131e30433a6d95f successMessageT: Thank you. This should keep the UNTAR folks quiet while they pretend to care about the current situation.
sources.69614f3852b2d48240d8d604 successMessageT: This is great. With UNTAR less focused on us, maybe they can finally concentrate on what actually matters.
sources.69614f3852b2d48240d8d604 acceptPlayerMes: Let's play UNTAR's game and make it look like we actually care about this failed operation of theirs. Get a bit closer to their representative around here, and we'll move forward that way.
sources.6961dfcf46370012416ab8a9 successMessageT: Well done. We’ll update the software as quickly as possible for your next mission.
sources.6961dfcf46370012416ab8a9 acceptPlayerMes:
That minimally positive relationship with Peacekeeper actually bore fruit. We received word from some UNTAR officers that certain TerraGroup items will be collected for forensics. They’re starting at Shoreline with the assets at the Smuggler's Base.

Let’s start this game with something light. We need to track those items, but UNTAR isn't that stupid. We’re going to disguise some common devices as mobile phones among those TerraGroup items. To do this, we need to revive an old tracking software located on a flash drive inside the Lab, specifically in the Yellow area. Collect the flash drive, eliminate some targets, and deliver it to our drop-off point at Lighthouse—a burnt-out bus on the main road.

Good luck!
sources.69628af1245be7fe53193f4c successMessageT: Thank you. This will allow us to intercept the transport and better understand what they are looking for.
sources.69628af1245be7fe53193f4c acceptPlayerMes:
The software is updated. While we prepare the next tasks, you need to set up the devices. Take these 1GPhones and the flash drive—your Intelligence Center should be able to handle the job even if it’s not fully upgraded.

Once you have the devices ready, head to the Smuggler's Base on Shoreline and plant them near the TerraGroup items. When UNTAR collects them, they’ll assume the phones are part of the evidence and take them along.

All your objectives are close to each other, so search inside and around one of the upper warehouses. Good luck!
sources.6961a8cf8e0990358ff6db97 successMessageT: Hmm. Thank you. Did you read this letter? Well, I suppose we can talk about that later. I need to make some calls.
sources.6961a8cf8e0990358ff6db97 acceptPlayerMes: Dammit! We have a problem. One of our informants reported that a letter from a VIP scientist is mixed in with the belongings you tagged. It must be of extreme importance for us to understand what's happening. I need you to go back urgently, search the areas where you planted the devices for that letter, and bring it to me.
sources.6962f2798e50b93c4bccd95b acceptPlayerMes: Hello, mercenary. We’ve intercepted communications that some UNTAR officers are patrolling Shoreline. I know this isn't ideal, but we cannot allow them to interfere with the mission in any way. Neutralize them as non-lethally as possible and without being identified.
sources.6962f2798e50b93c4bccd95b failMessageText: Well, so you're one of those people who doesn't like violence? Fair enough.
sources.6963c6ff4dae57a2dec4ef82 successMessageT: Great. You don't exactly strike me as the peaceful resolution type, but this was a positive outcome.
sources.6963c6ff4dae57a2dec4ef82 acceptPlayerMes: Hello, mercenary! I noticed you're having some trouble finding the UNTAR officers. Don't worry, they are already in my agents' sights as well. Regardless, we can bolster our counterintelligence operation, and that should be enough. Get me some items, and I’ll consider your task complete.
sources.6963c6ff4dae57a2dec4ef82 failMessageText: Now UNTAR won't be on our tail anymore—that'll do
sources.69648a944599e194c4f71339 successMessageT: Thank you for all the effort. Very strange items and a container... Well, it seems we have a lot of work ahead of us.
sources.69648a944599e194c4f71339 acceptPlayerMes: Things are getting very strange on this end. Did you read that letter? I hope not—after all, I didn't ask you to. Regardless, the letter mentions a parallel TerraGroup operation involving new contractors, which has obviously piqued my interest. I spent a long time investigating this and found nothing—absolutely nothing. But I doubt it's a lie. The only thing I discovered is that a PMC was kidnapped near the Port on Shoreline; he was camping in a green truck when he vanished. I need you to find any clues about this.
sources.6966997707f67fea67fe3e18 startedMessageT: My team is looking into the card, and I’ve already contacted a few people regarding that dogtag. As for the container, we couldn't get it open no matter what we tried. I’ve asked Mechanic to take a look, so I need you to deliver it to him. After that, we’ll continue investigating. Sources have informed me that Sanitar is holding some vital information inside the TerraGroup Lab. Let's solve two problems at once: eliminate Sanitar, secure the card, and find that information in The Lab. Good luck!
sources.6966997707f67fea67fe3e18 successMessageT: Thank you very much! We’ll check this flash drive, but this radio... it doesn't look like something Sanitar and his boys would use. High-end military model. We’ll investigate this.
sources.69892a1e2a1bffdacffb1b70 successMessageT: Thank you very much! I've informed the contact that the payment was made, and he has begun working on the flash drive.
sources.6989641b1ee424d6c211066f successMessageT: Excellent. These items will help us piece together this puzzle.
sources.698a7d1a29aa7cda419b8fbf successMessageT: Thank you. This will help treat everyone faster. And we aren't going to let this cowardly attack slide.
sources.698a82e7f718234ac7702f3d successMessageT: Yeah... even with us taking it easy on you, you did well. Congratulations.
sources.69a4ae470be691089eeaab09 successMessageT: Great work, team. You never disappoint.
sources.69b387e8956508586537b309 successMessageT: Thank you. Well, the information Ref brought us is still quite generic. Buying explosives? We need something more.
sources.69b43d6bab729e30d1339eaa successMessageT: I'm glad you managed to negotiate with him. Come on, tell me what you found.
sources.69b59b1983251afdcdc79efc successMessageT: Did you get everything? Great! I feel like better news is on the way.
sources.69e5737ac3095fb436e8d7cc successMessageT: You've got to be kidding me. Isn't the headache with TerraGroup enough, and now I have to worry about UNTAR? This seems too serious to be true. Let's keep moving.
sources.69e59b40d943343162400671 successMessageT: This is a lot of high-end equipment... Wait, easy now. Let's be careful with this hard drive so it isn't another explosive... Thank you, mercenary!
sources.69eb030da45329478b565651 successMessageT: Did you make the deliveries? Great! Let's keep treading very carefully.
sources.69ec636b09e1a0e9b511a7e5 successMessageT: Very well! We can understand the plan as a whole now.
sources.6a3cb7cff815823fa45ce5d8 successMessageT: Very well! We can understand the plan as a whole now.
sources.6a3db1cab8a16aeffe0b456d successMessageT: So that's it... UNTAR, TerraGroup, and USEC high command involved in the operation. Yeah, I think I know what to do, and we have a lot of work ahead of us.
sources.6a61340adcbc9728913c5d1a successMessageT: Traces and more traces, let's keep collecting them to put pressure on UNTAR.
sources.6a616a90b61bd3ebefa646c3 successMessageT: Great! That will clear the way for our people to move forward with local operations.
sources.6a61720444238176fd1217ae successMessageT: The operation was a success. I'm sending some STFs to turn the place upside down. Await updates.
sources.6a61916627589288ff590365 successMessageT: Great! Thank you very much. With all these parts, we can finish repairing the sensors.
sources.6a619e8e5b0bb16d5b09ee17 successMessageT: Thank you! We'll monitor the transmissions. As for the vehicles, still heavily loaded? With all those Scavs around? Strange.
sources.6a6695c403c45274988758fe successMessageT: T H I C C cases? These guys are really balling. Hm... no explosives, okay... let's see what's inside.
sources.6a66ad2a3fb733233d32a26e successMessageT: Everything went smoothly, I hope you enjoy it. We are getting into stranger territories in this story.
sources.6a67dba824293fdf6e9ba83e successMessageT:
These maniacs aren't just funding gear to keep the conflict in Tarkov between BEAR and USEC going; they are facilitating the arming of a secret TerraGroup cell.

This needs to end, or this place will never be at peace.
sources.6a680e36dc45fd15657209c2 successMessageT: The final operation before the War against UNTAR is about to begin.
sources.6a68172d4c48714815c5bcb8 successMessageT: One step closer. You'd better prepare yourself now, because what's coming... will be big.
sources.6a6930180b052dcd27aa3b7c successMessageT: Operation complete, and it was a tremendous success. We will await UNTAR's next moves.
sources.690af7eaf5a597ebc0b602f6 acceptPlayerMes:
Have you ever seen that acronym around? “ISB”… For a long time, we were USEC’s special division, but honestly, this whole thing is getting ridiculous. It’s not just the leadership that’s a failure—it’s this TerraGroup, with all its corruption and exploitation. That kind of shit always happens, and whatever—but they’re up to something much worse, and we have evidence that someone else big is involved in all this chaos in Tarkov. 

The reason I’m wasting my time telling you this is that to work with the “ISB,” you have to prove yourself. How about that.
sources.690e2689cbd10f2ac5e766eb failMessageText: Don't say I didn't warn you
sources.c3dd45d0da2679c60db3c3cb failMessageText: You already have a direct contact.
sources.690bcb580b8f9c461c3eae53 successMessageT: Good job! With these documents, we can advance our plans.
sources.690d8ad1750d535b2e9bc135 successMessageT: Good job! With this, we can establish contact.
sources.690d8ad1750d535b2e9bc135 failMessageText: You handed this over to Fence!? He's part of a Scav legion; do you want to end this or create an even bigger conflict?
sources.690bb986148ac0cfb2669d32 successMessageT: Great! Don't forget to be careful.
sources.690a531eee4e5b9753c9e1f5 acceptPlayerMes: I know, she seems tough. The truth is, based on what my research shows, she’s part of a special USEC unit, and to this day, everyone in it remains loyal to her. Maybe she’s not used to the way mercenaries operate. In any case, I’ll act as a go-between and show her that you’re worth it—just give me a few good items to use as bargaining chips with her.
sources.690a531eee4e5b9753c9e1f5 successMessageT: Great. We can rebuild things this way.
sources.690f6e1e9e966ad660423991 acceptPlayerMes: She is satisfied with your previous performance. I have a few leftover orders from her; find the equipment and bring it. Don't forget to test it; they are very fresh and require fully functional weapons.
sources.690f6e1e9e966ad660423991 successMessageT: Very good, mercenary! Maybe it's time for you to reconnect with her.
sources.69a9df0ea81c67206b147080 successMessageT: Good luck, mercenary! Keep me updated if you learn anything new.
sources.690a239a90debae535eb1ac3 acceptPlayerMes: Jaeger connected you with someone who has no idea what they might cause. She sent you to interfere with my things. I trusted you with a task, and you acted behind my back, so you are going to fix this by installing some signal disruptors on the pillars beneath the offices. One on each end and one in the middle should be enough.
sources.690a239a90debae535eb1ac3 successMessageT: Thank you, mercenary! I hope you'll be careful from now on if you truly wish to continue working with me... or with her.
sources.69116657e03993e509cc307a acceptPlayerMes:
Jaeger played a fundamental role in aligning my interests with Aishi's, and I think both she and I can benefit from certain jobs, as long as she doesn't keep interfering with what I do. 

Her team ordered new personalized equipment. I need you to find it for me. I will make some modifications to them so they better suit the purposes.
sources.69116657e03993e509cc307a successMessageT: Great work, mercenary! I will be working on this equipment as soon as possible. Expect new orders soon.
sources.691240a442a8c7334f0aa46e acceptPlayerMes: Hello, mercenary. The last modifications were great. I had to replace some of the original parts you brought, but everything went as planned. We have a second batch of orders.
sources.691240a442a8c7334f0aa46e successMessageT: Thank you! This equipment will be very useful for Aishi and her team. Expect more orders soon.
sources.691242e82f0f4e08fcbcd657 acceptPlayerMes: Hello again, mercenary! Aishi and her people are quite satisfied with our work so far. We are working on a project for her Special Forces, and I hope you can bring me some more equipment. It needs to be of excellent quality.
sources.691242e82f0f4e08fcbcd657 successMessageT: Very good, mercenary. High-quality equipment like this is what forges extremely special gear.
sources.69667e55c24001ace1f3b128 successMessageT: Evidence? If that's really what this is about, it's highly unlikely there's a self-destruct system. No one would risk destroying the evidence. I'll look for some contacts who might have more information on how we can open this without damaging anything.
sources.69667e55c24001ace1f3b128 acceptPlayerMes: Hello, mercenary! Aishi informed me you were coming. So, this is the container? It looks like a standard Beta-model Container, but it definitely seems to have some papers inside. There are security mechanisms, like the ink packs used in some banks, designed to self-destruct documents; because of that, we'd better understand exactly what this is and what's inside before we try to pry it open. I'll study what I can, but as for the discovering and investigating? That's your job.
sources.6a3cb815f609da9f045ce5df successMessageT: Did you manage to plant the Flash Drive? Great! Let's wait.
sources.6a3cc68cf7263a67e12db4ac successMessageT: Great! Simple as that. Here are the files, ready to be read.
sources.69a9e3cfe2ad4cc47d96cf22 successMessageT: Great, my friend! We shall do good business together.
sources.69b44c601144e4b33bdb9e9c successMessageT: Thank you very much, friend. This will be very beneficial for both sides in the end. I look forward to your next contact.
sources.69b59f5cd76c01b7117e2712 successMessageT: Nice work, partner! You get it, don't you? It's just business.
sources.6a6acfb64d8f7b3935a30e22 successMessageT: Is the area secure? Then let's proceed. Thank you!
sources.6a6ad307b056d89f85a30e2f successMessageT: We're moving quite fast. Very good.
sources.6a6bf9b4e9edcd20cefd27ad successMessageT: So she was the one who silenced those Raiders? Hmm... interesting. Let's see where this goes.
sources.6a6aa8e25ce77038f78f5360 successMessageT: Confirmed. The signal stopped. Now we just need to get them off that route.
sources.6a6ab405957e20e3ed0af439 successMessageT: Good, Lotus' stashes are secure. Moving on.
sources.6a6be0db93f4ebb01828169d successMessageT: Thank you for the help. And thank Lotus as well.
sources.6a6abd124b41bb872e356393 successMessageT: The ink isn't that dry, this isn't that old. And "Black Division"? I'll talk to Partisan, and as for you, you'd better talk to Aishi.
sources.6a6ac726864c233c4ea30e11 successMessageT: Very good, partner! Maybe this will have a positive outcome.
sources.5f369eeac01a188bc7dc06d0 successMessageT: You did well. Let's move on.
sources.935421a346e854a6d2337c37 successMessageT: Mechanic and Jaeger trust you. That's enough for the next stage.
sources.f999ba37e8dda410954c0c1f successMessageT: A single guard. The warning has been delivered.
sources.f999ba37e8dda410954c0c1f failMessageText: You crossed the imposed limit. I do not tolerate failure.
sources.4660ba9168903321ed40bfee successMessageT: Eight raids and zero ISB casualties. You've shown the discipline I needed.
sources.4660ba9168903321ed40bfee failMessageText: You crossed the imposed limit. I do not tolerate failure.
sources.0ca9dfa7d14d42f2bd5acdb0 startedMessageT: Let me know when you're done.
sources.0ca9dfa7d14d42f2bd5acdb0 successMessageT: Very well, thank you! This will help relieve our forces in The Lab.
sources.db3b1511110c41cdbab6d4f6 successMessageT: High-end gear and dogtags with no identification... great.
sources.8b708ff6d7e641e38f6f2be0 startedMessageT: These guys aren't messing around. The only thing we've managed to find so far is an acronym: "BD". Some of my Operatives reported seeing them stash some electronics in their pockets during combat. They also saw one of them locking down a laptop. I need their devices as soon as possible.
sources.8b708ff6d7e641e38f6f2be0 successMessageT: Great, we have some good material to investigate. Thank you!
sources.8367ca4830984afeb8551aaa successMessageT: You didn't break any of these vials, did you? Good, we have enough. Let's keep the items in quarantine while our researchers analyze this.
sources.5387285ba1624dab9ac06d72 successMessageT: You are doing very well. Let me see this. Hm... the chest patch says "Black Division", so that's what "BD" stands for. Great. Thank you!
sources.0b69f84d68d74db7b5dea117 successMessageT: Great, very good! This way we'll be able to access the rooms much easier, don't forget to always take a look inside a few of them too.
sources.a3f407eb22cd41769e6f4c5f successMessageT: The place is almost stabilized. Good. We'll give you updates as soon as we better understand the situation.
sources.52588eccea984354a13b53f4 successMessageT: Dealt with them? Great! I knew I could count on you.
sources.52588eccea984354a13b53f4 failMessageText: What is your problem with my people? I will remember this!
sources.1184c00a9ec847be987be767 successMessageT: That's a lot of data! Thank you!
sources.1184c00a9ec847be987be767 failMessageText: You've got to be kidding me. You'll regret this.
sources.cd993bfe6ed447dcaab85d04 successMessageT: Good job. This changes our options.
sources.cd993bfe6ed447dcaab85d04 failMessageText: You chose the other side. I will remember this.
