sources.52588eccea984354a13b53f4 startedMessageT: Neutralize 20 Raiders or PMCs in The Lab. Completing this task fails the opposing trader’s task.
sources.1184c00a9ec847be987be767 startedMessageT: Hand over 5 Unidentified Operators' SSDs. Completing this task fails the opposing trader’s task.
sources.cd993bfe6ed447dcaab85d04 startedMessageT: Neutralize Unidentified Operators in The Lab. Completing this task fails the opposing trader’s task.
sources.55ccb3bc5af1428fb03001df successMessageT: Great job. I knew you would do well.
sources.dd715e78ab984c14909da407 successMessageT: Are you okay? Yeah... we're going to need a lot of work there.
sources.f1a90496778649e8b955e60d successMessageT: Phew, you got out? Well done!
sources.a38b841cae6d46dab703e8eb successMessageT: We are making progress. Soon we will be able to restore power to The Lab.
sources.c9304d1a70414b398f840595 successMessageT: You reactivated all the power? That's great! Just be careful, it probably won't last between raids. The system is a mess.
sources.9dfc181b7e2944bd9d40308b successMessageT: You did great. Thanks to you we can stabilize the lab soon.
sources.a5933b154fe34593947956c8 successMessageT: Got them all? That's great! Here's your payment.
sources.a5933b154fe34593947956c8 failMessageText: It's up to you, but don't say I didn't warn you.
sources.688a35cea49a4833a17c74b0 successMessageT: Great! Very great indeed! Thanks for this, partner!
sources.85baf5fc8723406a88b049a5 successMessageT: You really are good, huh? Took them all out! Here is your reward.
sources.85baf5fc8723406a88b049a5 failMessageText: Would you rather play against me? Fine! You know what I think about that!
sources.1f6a892b5dda4241868ffd09 successMessageT: This way I will stop losing people. Thanks, partner!
sources.e4e78f48c1e44d898e8ad5e3 successMessageT: Custom look? Very cool. Thank you, mercenary!
sources.64e6df2f30554b3ea6e4e1c9 successMessageT: You found the virus? Great! Keep in touch, in case you have been exposed.
sources.35dc82a3c84b4c0a8a0646d8 successMessageT: You found their SSD? Great! We can proceed now.
sources.10413f0d043844c6a69a88db successMessageT: Good job! Did you find the password?
sources.637a389d84da48a4a34dfd17 successMessageT: You don't disappoint, do you? Very well done!
sources.8e4f5535e0bf4135b8a90ec7 completePlayerM: Files secured. The operation is complete.
sources.8e4f5535e0bf4135b8a90ec7 successMessageT: The operation is complete. Thank you! You were of great help; we won't forget this.
sources.ca7b2ef7bca84efe967f9b40 successMessageT: Good job. We can move forward.
sources.a3b3fae920584af7b941a2fc successMessageT: These antidotes will save lives. Thank you.
sources.6e49a30eafa8409bbf623897 successMessageT: I will study these objects carefully. You've brought us a valuable clue.
sources.aee00b2dc375dce6a12450d0 successMessageT: Ah. There we are. Scratches, dirt, wear. History. No, I wasn't smelling it. Take the beer; I don't drink. Come back later.
sources.aee00b2dc375dce6a12450d0 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.ad9c91314a6c311c3ec9cbc7 startedMessageT: Good. One of each. Keep them separate.
sources.ad9c91314a6c311c3ec9cbc7 successMessageT: Good. One of each. That's all the alcohol I had, by the way. Tea and chocolate are much more civilised.
sources.ad9c91314a6c311c3ec9cbc7 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.2ab7e1da342dbdc151803e69 startedMessageT: Level twenty-five or higher. I will notice.
sources.2ab7e1da342dbdc151803e69 successMessageT: Much better. The edges have history. People record experience with numbers; the metal keeps another record. Take the vodka and ammunition. I found them. They're no use to me.
sources.2ab7e1da342dbdc151803e69 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.eed4c1f2f4515018fca28da0 startedMessageT: Five. Any five. This should be straightforward.
sources.eed4c1f2f4515018fca28da0 successMessageT: Five. Good. That fits rather nicely. Take the crackers and condensed milk. I bought too much. No, I don't know why.
sources.eed4c1f2f4515018fca28da0 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.37ad5422d1ed717a2e87d0ca startedMessageT: Four BEAR. Two USEC. In that ratio.
sources.37ad5422d1ed717a2e87d0ca successMessageT: Four and two. Correct. Your payment is over there: meat, toilet paper and shotgun shells. They're not related.
sources.37ad5422d1ed717a2e87d0ca acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.ec2dcb5e6b514ad343744a2d startedMessageT: Seventeen or higher. Four of them.
sources.ec2dcb5e6b514ad343744a2d successMessageT: Four. Seventeen or above. Good. Seventeen rounds of M80 too. Yes, also seventeen. Take the water and bulbs while you're at it.
sources.ec2dcb5e6b514ad343744a2d acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.d82f1b248a0232e53006ca00 startedMessageT: Seven tags and the beer. The bottle is the important part.
sources.d82f1b248a0232e53006ca00 successMessageT: Yes, that's the bottle. Probably. They all look remarkably similar. Take the ammunition and the contents of that drawer. None of it is related.
sources.d82f1b248a0232e53006ca00 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.72362110d1f507767b8aabaf startedMessageT: Nine. And remind me about the box under the desk.
sources.72362110d1f507767b8aabaf successMessageT: Nine. Good. Take the box, and those parts beside it. If I injure myself on any of them again I'm holding you responsible.
sources.72362110d1f507767b8aabaf acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.1cdaa539513c7192a52b2f0a startedMessageT: Fifteen. Try not to make a hobby of this.
sources.1cdaa539513c7192a52b2f0a successMessageT: Fifteen. Reassuring quantity. Unfortunately they all need sorting now. Take the ammunition, tape, and the peas. They're peas.
sources.1cdaa539513c7192a52b2f0a acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.c93d221e4b72a43bd8de15d4 startedMessageT: Coffee first. Five tags second. Preferably in that order.
sources.c93d221e4b72a43bd8de15d4 successMessageT: Coffee. Five tags. Birthday. Good enough. Apparently people exchange gifts on birthdays, so take those attachments. Technically I think you're supposed to give them to me, but that seems inefficient.
sources.c93d221e4b72a43bd8de15d4 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.a9071cc02877f30fb09e1118 successMessageT: Five and five. Excellent. Take the medical gear and the suppressor. You do get shot at rather a lot. That's an observation, not concern.
sources.a9071cc02877f30fb09e1118 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.b650c014ce2da9678c4e3880 startedMessageT: Three BEAR. Eight USEC. Yes, deliberately uneven.
sources.b650c014ce2da9678c4e3880 successMessageT: Three. Eight. Eleven. Less attractive, more useful. I dislike statistics. Take the ammunition and gunpowder; they're your problem now.
sources.b650c014ce2da9678c4e3880 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.1d11cbc194a45afe5f8d91cf startedMessageT: Five USEC. Level twenty-three or higher. Please hurry.
sources.1d11cbc194a45afe5f8d91cf successMessageT: Yes. There. Much better. I don't know how I was supposed to work with that staring at me all day. Take that rifle; someone gave it to me as payment. Apparently it's rather good.
sources.1d11cbc194a45afe5f8d91cf acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.96a8d109cd42b725b00320ec startedMessageT: Ten experienced operators. Level thirty or higher.
sources.96a8d109cd42b725b00320ec successMessageT: Ten experienced operators. Different factions, different wear, no obvious pattern. They're all dead, yes; I had noticed. That's rather the problem. Take the armour, medicine and ammunition. Perhaps they'll be useful.
sources.96a8d109cd42b725b00320ec acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.91646996e6ceb4b7f6f75bc9 startedMessageT: Six and six. Same threshold. Different training.
sources.91646996e6ceb4b7f6f75bc9 successMessageT: Six and six. Nothing useful. Do you people deliberately make yourselves statistically inconvenient? I've put equipment aside for you. Use it properly. Reliable suppliers are difficult to replace.
sources.91646996e6ceb4b7f6f75bc9 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.3247908b2e049cb2a4f9ff61 startedMessageT: Forty. Yes, forty. We have discussed your hoarding.
sources.3247908b2e049cb2a4f9ff61 successMessageT: Forty. You actually had forty. That's slightly concerning. I've taken the liberty of helping: here's a new case. It's empty. Try to use it responsibly.
sources.3247908b2e049cb2a4f9ff61 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.1f07a929ab26733759f54555 startedMessageT: Three this time. See? Perfectly reasonable.
sources.1f07a929ab26733759f54555 successMessageT: Three. Good. I recognise the previous assignment may have been... inconvenient. This isn't compensation. Stop smiling.
sources.1f07a929ab26733759f54555 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.dd0e8d708283c0aa46ab70b8 startedMessageT: One USEC. Four BEAR. Keep the groups distinct.
sources.dd0e8d708283c0aa46ab70b8 successMessageT: There. Four here, one there. Cover, ammunition, a defensible position... yes, he might make it. Take the rig and magazines. Apparently sixty rounds is useful when four people are trying to kill you.
sources.dd0e8d708283c0aa46ab70b8 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.9f48571604b7bad741012db0 startedMessageT: Six USEC. Two BEAR. Level twenty-eight or higher.
sources.9f48571604b7bad741012db0 successMessageT: Good. If he'd had a decent headset, like one of these, communications would have been better. The injectors would have helped too. Take them. Actually, I don't need any. Take all of them.
sources.9f48571604b7bad741012db0 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.06322b8096b190250b040787 startedMessageT: Three USEC. Seven BEAR. Level thirty-two or higher.
sources.06322b8096b190250b040787 successMessageT: There. He's out of ammunition forty-three seconds before the others. Completely avoidable. If he'd carried three magazines like these he'd still be fighting. Carry enough. And take the bandage.
sources.06322b8096b190250b040787 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.36cffca1f19896687dc65992 startedMessageT: Four and four. This one is about what happens after the plan fails.
sources.36cffca1f19896687dc65992 successMessageT: Four and four. If he moves here, treats the bleeding immediately... yes. He gets out. Not comfortably, but he gets out. Take the armour, medicine and ammunition. I've accounted for the most likely failures.
sources.36cffca1f19896687dc65992 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.c4a117cee0f216e5f128a018 startedMessageT: Seven BEAR. Nine USEC. No scenarios this time.
sources.c4a117cee0f216e5f128a018 successMessageT: Seven. Nine. Sixteen. Good. Facts are easier; they don't change because you'd prefer a different answer. Take the card and water. Hydration is important. That's general advice.
sources.c4a117cee0f216e5f128a018 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.7e6b06e38ec82a77012b404b startedMessageT: Six tags. Level thirty-three or higher. That should correct it.
sources.7e6b06e38ec82a77012b404b successMessageT: Six. There. Corrected. I prefer problems with solutions. Your payment is over there: sixty-six rounds. Yes, sixty-six. That's the correct quantity. Don't start.
sources.7e6b06e38ec82a77012b404b acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.7823e877629e7dcf22f72331 startedMessageT: A standard Glock. Standard means unmodified.
sources.7823e877629e7dcf22f72331 successMessageT: I still don't see the appeal. Although the sight was crude, the controls untidy, the magazine inadequate... I made some adjustments. Take this one instead. I don't need two.
sources.7823e877629e7dcf22f72331 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.2a649124d2a8231fa999b488 startedMessageT: Five tags. Then I want your opinion.
sources.2a649124d2a8231fa999b488 successMessageT: Good. Five. Now, these. One lets you see heat, which seems extraordinarily unfair, so naturally I included it. The other is for longer distances. Try them. Everything I know about firearms is relatively recent.
sources.2a649124d2a8231fa999b488 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.4930760967b54ecbdf0de1c2 startedMessageT: Eight tags. I have some things to clear out.
sources.4930760967b54ecbdf0de1c2 successMessageT: Eight. Your payment is there. Yes, all of them. Sell them, strip them, throw them at somebody. Last time I gave you two extremely good ones. It averages out.
sources.4930760967b54ecbdf0de1c2 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.9fa096456797de612a502e05 startedMessageT: Three BEAR. Five USEC. Something familiar.
sources.9fa096456797de612a502e05 successMessageT: Eight tags. Good. No rails, no mounting standards, no arguments about barrel length. Take all the gun parts too; I'm clearing the drawer before I'm tempted to build something else.
sources.9fa096456797de612a502e05 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.c6ca9c38f4541c085b962f43 startedMessageT: One graphics card and five tags. Apparently this is progress.
sources.c6ca9c38f4541c085b962f43 successMessageT: That's considerably larger than I expected. Where does it go? Never mind. How complicated can replacing one component possibly be? Take the spare electronics. I may have labelled some incorrectly.
sources.c6ca9c38f4541c085b962f43 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.30a704732647ff8a8615a745 startedMessageT: Cable, power filter, six tags. I have a list now.
sources.30a704732647ff8a8615a745 successMessageT: Neither of these fits. Of course they don't. Apparently I've misunderstood something fundamental. Take the electronics; they were in the same box and I'm beginning to resent the entire category. Technology is stupid.
sources.30a704732647ff8a8615a745 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.d3c7160860d97d80ccb9135a successMessageT: Nine. Perfect. Drop one on the floor? Still works. Get it wet? Still works. No updates, no passwords, no fucking cables. ...Excuse me. That was unnecessary. I've had a difficult evening. Take what is left of the computer.
sources.d3c7160860d97d80ccb9135a acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.3eb264a90ae286106a23c6f7 startedMessageT: Three. Any three. Read the names before you hand them over.
sources.3eb264a90ae286106a23c6f7 successMessageT: Three people. I wonder whether anyone still expects one of them to come home. I've spent a great deal of time studying how people die; perhaps I've neglected that they lived first. Strange. I don't suppose I've ever considered who would look for me.
sources.3eb264a90ae286106a23c6f7 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.2348be9a1126aa50393bd717 startedMessageT: Paper, flash drives and five tags. Paper cannot crash.
sources.2348be9a1126aa50393bd717 successMessageT: Paper. Excellent. Flash drives... I've just realised I have nothing to plug those into. Never mind. I've started adding notes about the tags now, not just numbers. It makes the records less efficient. I think I prefer them that way.
sources.2348be9a1126aa50393bd717 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.f59a6554361e1943b5757620 startedMessageT: Seven tags and the painkillers. My hand is fine.
sources.f59a6554361e1943b5757620 successMessageT: Seven more names. I'm beginning to understand why computers were invented. I'm not rebuilding it. The notes are getting longer now. Questions, mostly. Some of them I will never answer. I no longer mind the empty space.
sources.f59a6554361e1943b5757620 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.70494923f4313a0836047a56 startedMessageT: The glasses, painkillers and six tags. Do not comment on the lighting.
sources.70494923f4313a0836047a56 successMessageT: Much better. Although... no. The light probably isn't the problem. Never mind. Take this key. Apparently it opens somewhere interesting. Going outside to investigate a mysterious locked room seems an excellent way to become part of my collection.
sources.70494923f4313a0836047a56 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.3a70daa9069403bb0c87aac6 startedMessageT: Eight tags, cigarettes and vodka. I am broadening the sample.
sources.3a70daa9069403bb0c87aac6 successMessageT: Cigarettes. Vodka. A tag tells me who somebody was once they're dead; these tell me something while they're alive. What they drink, smoke, what they thought they'd need. More interesting than I expected. Take the consumables back.
sources.3a70daa9069403bb0c87aac6 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.973423fe59d81b2e92440278 startedMessageT: The golden pistol and five tags. I want to know who chose it.
sources.973423fe59d81b2e92440278 successMessageT: So this belonged to one particular man. A tag identifies someone because somebody stamped it; this tells me something because he chose it himself. Interesting. Take it back. It isn't mine. Take the rest too; I have more money than uses for it.
sources.973423fe59d81b2e92440278 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.dc793bba6878ebbe565111ad startedMessageT: Ten tags, food, drink and cigarettes. Ordinary things matter too.
sources.dc793bba6878ebbe565111ad successMessageT: The tag tells us what happened. The food tells us they weren't expecting it to happen. That's a significant difference. Anyway, I've become philosophical about canned goods. Let's not encourage that.
sources.dc793bba6878ebbe565111ad acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.adfc9ce5811d699712afe9f7 startedMessageT: Twenty. And no, you are not getting another case.
sources.adfc9ce5811d699712afe9f7 successMessageT: Twenty. Good. You knew perfectly well this might happen again. Your payment is there. No dogtag case. The storage case is different. Completely different. Don't start.
sources.adfc9ce5811d699712afe9f7 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.b76e9343162ab87053e87365 successMessageT: Yes. And you read the name? Good. After twenty at once, I thought perhaps we'd both forgotten what these actually were. Take those rifles. I made a few improvements. Apparently I occasionally relapse.
sources.b76e9343162ab87053e87365 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.768f4d12c1e2626be439a16d startedMessageT: Five more. I am clearing a few things up.
sources.768f4d12c1e2626be439a16d successMessageT: Five. Thank you. That section is complete. I've accumulated rather a lot of money, equipment and keys simply because I didn't need anything. Keeping things merely because you can seems rather pointless. Take these. I'm keeping the collection; I'm not finished with that yet.
sources.768f4d12c1e2626be439a16d acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.b0f2dc120737ed220986b818 startedMessageT: Three tags and an energy drink. Do not make anything of it.
sources.b0f2dc120737ed220986b818 successMessageT: Three. Still doesn't balance. I used to believe every discrepancy could be found and corrected. Apparently some things don't. Never mind. Take these. I have no reason to keep them now. Don't. I'm tired, that's all.
sources.b0f2dc120737ed220986b818 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.271dc61a970a7724a9bb53a0 startedMessageT: Water, energy, the bear and one tag. Yes, the bear too.
sources.271dc61a970a7724a9bb53a0 successMessageT: Thank you. There's something I should probably tell you. I don't think I have that long left on earth. I don't know precisely how long. I thought if I could balance it, calculate a way through every scenario, perhaps I could avoid this. Position, equipment, preparation. Enough variables, enough planning, and there would be an answer. There isn't. You can do everything correctly and still run out of time. Please stop looking at me like that. I'm still here.
sources.271dc61a970a7724a9bb53a0 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.f5ac229732049aea48fc9625 startedMessageT: One tag and some paper. I need to write something down.
sources.f5ac229732049aea48fc9625 successMessageT: I've added you to the records. Not the collection. Obviously. Your name. You're the only person I've dealt with regularly enough that it seemed strange not to have you written down somewhere. I suppose that's an address book. Mine has one entry. Very efficient. The rest of the papers are in order too. There won't be much left for you to sort out.
sources.f5ac229732049aea48fc9625 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.a7641df3fd811bc1ef2bcf19 startedMessageT: Two beers. One for you and one for me. Do not make a thing of it.
sources.a7641df3fd811bc1ef2bcf19 successMessageT: I still don't particularly like beer. But I see the appeal; it isn't really about the beer. You brought the first bottle back, and then you kept coming back. I spent most of my life assuming I didn't need people. Rather inconveniently, you proved me wrong. I'm glad I knew you. My affairs are in order, and I intend to rest now. Stay a little longer, if you can.
sources.a7641df3fd811bc1ef2bcf19 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.104094c6b6ff8c11b7d91153 startedMessageT: There is nothing to bring me this time.
sources.104094c6b6ff8c11b7d91153 successMessageT:
The collection stays where it is; it was never mine to give away. I've left you an empty case. Look at the names occasionally. Knowing something ends doesn't make the time before it less valuable. Thank you for staying. You made these last days better than I expected them to be.

The books balance. Finally.

Oh, and one last thing. The name's Pavel. Thought you ought to know.
sources.104094c6b6ff8c11b7d91153 acceptPlayerMes: I'll see what I can do.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000001 startedMessageT: Two meals. Two waters. Try not to turn procurement into an adventure.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000001 successMessageT: Good. Inventory accounted for. I've opened one of the restricted armor racks.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000001 failMessageText: Impressive. You managed to lose a logistics task.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000001 changeQuestMess: The manifest changed. The requirement did not.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000002 startedMessageT: Five tags. Legible. I have enough mysteries in the inventory system already.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000002 successMessageT: Good. Five names removed from the manifest. One restricted rifle is now on your purchase list.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000003 startedMessageT: Ten experienced operators. Level fifteen minimum.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000003 successMessageT: Enough. The restricted cabinet is open. Better protection and premium ammunition are now on the books.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000003 failMessageText: Restricted means restricted. Come back when the paperwork is convincing.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000003 acceptPlayerMes: Open the cabinet when I get back.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000004 startedMessageT: Customs. Twelve scavengers. Keep my route open.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000004 successMessageT: Route is moving again. I've added another set of premium armor and head protection to your account.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000005 startedMessageT: Eight tags. Level twenty-five or better. No tourists.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000005 successMessageT: The ledger balances. Another premium rifle and another AP allocation are now available to you.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000006 startedMessageT: Eight PMCs down. Twelve level-thirty tags on my desk. Then we discuss the black rack.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000006 successMessageT: Contract closed. The black rack is yours to buy from: elite rifle, armor, helmet, and the remaining premium ammunition I can source.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000006 failMessageText: Priority inventory stays sealed until the contract is complete.
sources.67471f9c63d6ef6fe3ced898 successMessaget: I'm impressed. Looks like you really are reliable, thats good. There is way more that you could help us with, I will give you access to more areas of our shop depending on what you help us with.
sources.67509b40ebc998b7d528d1a1 successMessaget: Amazing work, how was the ride? Did you find anything important? Very well then, don't forget to pick up your payment, you know where it is dropped off.
sources.67509c43d96ffa5a7187c025 successMessaget: Well done, as expected, maybe it was an easy task for you after all, right? And as always don't forget your payment.
sources.67509cb7f4536e3f9382009b successMessaget: Everything there? Perfect, well done soldier, you know where you'll find your reward I suppose.
sources.67509d5ecf08e0fbf1764f36 successMessaget: Awesome, the camera you installed works, and you said you found the way to the evac? Perfect.
sources.67509e7057be1b2849ca4f57 successMessaget: Seeing a shopping mall being so quiet surely is something interesting. Good work out there soldier, your payment will be waiting for you.
sources.674720e808312fa336c68ee6 successMessaget: Awesome work soldier, don't forget your payment, it should be on it's way.
sources.6747235ed723d48c90cb644f successMessaget: That would be enough for now, thank you.
sources.674721e986f435b80234da65 successMessaget: Fantastic, those should be everything we needed, thank you.
sources.67472251414d587b8b36ba1f successMessaget: Good work, I will think about the thing I talked about, alright?
sources.674722c60ad34fd118ec4c9e successMessaget: Those should be enough for now, thanks a lot. Don't forget to pick up your payment.
sources.674723bdd56b0c5b295bb6a1 successMessaget: I hope all of this will do for now, thank you very much.
sources.67472495fb91486f4fb89cb3 successMessaget: Well, looks like it went alright after all, I suppose it was not too difficult for you hmm?
sources.6766e795bcba079415915b6b successMessaget: That's it? I thought there was more behind these collectibles, well anyway, you know where to find the storage container.
sources.677a55a0be2a8922dab9e040 successMessaget: Both trucks still there? Did you find and mark them? Great, well done soldier, your pay is on it's way.
sources.67d769c37a074517a838b60b successMessaget: Outside warehouse four, and outside the bus station? Sounds good, I'll send another group of operators there to check it out. I hope nobody else gets too curious... Anyway don't forget your payment.
sources.67e96d27ddd9ca3c4adbb5d4 successMessaget: Well, shit... There's absolutely nothing in these documents! Just some sort of transaction reports - useless to us... But you did your part, you'll still receive your full payment. I'll see if I can obtain some details on these shipments.
sources.67e972c039c5f34295a24265 successMessaget: She just handed over the documents to you and let you stash them near one of our dead-drops? This is has to be some sort of trap, right? No? Hmm... That's some really suspicious situation, but I guess she has her reasons. Maybe working together will prove to be a wise choice - But don't forget, more work equals more money for you.
sources.67ea813bd8d2dc676746f53e successMessaget: Impressive, well now that this is taken care of it's time to move on, shall we? But give me some time to prepare the next thing.
sources.67ee61b9f56b571ce703eec4 successMessaget: Shipments still there? That's good. I hope the BTR driver had a job for you? I will contact you later, make sure to help out the driver before that.
sources.67efd429317486563c7ee2b2 successMessaget: So it's there, yeah? Alright alright, that's our next lead, I'll see what I can do.
sources.67f107c6cd96ce08caca8b83 successMessaget: Wow you did actually find them? Impressive, well I will take a look at them and contact you whenever I have something else. If I find something of course, expect this to take a while.
sources.677b03604996670857682f5c successMessaget: All quiet? Strange, I will do some research, I'm sure there is more behind it. I will contact you later, expect it at least to take a few hours.
sources.677b04f244d35a69206ec4e4 successMessaget: Wiped the floor with them? Good, remember that these clowns always come back and that this place is never safe at night. Anyway, here's your payment.
sources.674753f1d8d87605a4fcb912 successMessaget: Thank you, I will see what we can do with that info.
sources.674754bfd14fc231ec90d9d9 successMessaget: Thank you for your effort, here take this.
sources.674755987736d5ac91837615 successMessaget: My guys found the powerswitches from last time, good job. We will take a look at the mounted weapons as soon as possible.
sources.674756876ef598122bb9239d successMessaget: Good one, I hope you don't get used to that place too much tho, we will need you in other parts of the region soon.
sources.674757075b3b3631a4b3efd5 successMessaget: Is it done? Good, we will try to connect the camera somehow.
sources.6747575b5a841fdbf0ca37ae successMessaget: So it's true what he said... Hmm, strange. Thank you for your work tho, heres your reward.
sources.67475893d98f889c82fee39b successMessaget: Those should be enough, thanks, well done soldier.
sources.674758ea142f52a016ecd92d successMessaget: Great! Thanks for removing the trash from Tarkov's streets.
sources.67475931380e79bc84d831b9 successMessaget: Good work, glad to have someone that knows how to take risks.
sources.67475c58c8d4ae3b9baf7d38 successMessaget: Good good. We need as much information about that place as possible, so everything helps.
sources.67475dbb321ddf314e6fbcad successMessaget: Good one, warrior. I will take the weapons and the drinks from here on now.
sources.67475e21aeda0864d4faf7c4 successMessaget: Job's done? Excellent. You know where you can find your payment.
sources.674763ebeceb4fed8a506543 successMessaget: What? It's gone? Fantastic, someone got curious before we got there... I assume one of the other vendors sent people out for the same job. Well anyway, you did what you could, your payment will be the same don't worry.
sources.674764d429eb6b5966202149 successMessaget: Fantastic! Place was more quiet than ever... I think. Anyway, don't forget to check our stock, you might see some new things there.
sources.674765571af3e5be54af699a successMessaget: We got an image now, good job. We will observe the room for a while.
sources.6747652eea4bfbdfa2e46ab4 successMessaget: You can never be too careful these days, so don't take it personally. Anyway, enjoy these books, hopefully you can get a use out of them.
sources.6747659d16e95b47fe2caa09 successMessaget: Finished your work? Good, here is your payment.
sources.674766077f5e08878af90bc8 successMessaget: Got it, I am sending my guys to check them out, thank you soldier..
sources.6747666815fa03b3fc03a041 successMessaget: Are these all? Good to know, thank you soldier.
sources.67476842ad02e25c2e1b92ad successMessaget: Alright we found it, good work and thank you warrior.
sources.674768fd740e1d790ed07302 successMessaget: Looks like you scared the shit out of them, nice work. The cargo can be checked out in peace now.
sources.6747b30780131eae6aa2cc23 successMessaget: Well you did it, while you were busy I managed to modify some access cards so they can let you into the Lab as much as you want, I put it up for sale in our stock.
sources.6747b568ffb78dbbb8a7968d successMessaget: Wow you really are an expert when it comes to the lab? Well, thats good, and don't forget your payment.
sources.6747b5ed539d24e909acae8f successMessaget: Okay, good thing you found the bodies, I will try to find a way to get that information out of Tarkov. And where the offices empty? Strange, something should be still there, but thanks for the intel and data. Here is your payment.
sources.6747b6d1b00b3bfcb6b02f94 successMessaget: Looks like your work did not raise any suspicion, thats good, I will contact you very soon about the next job.
sources.6747b877505baa44d501d079 successMessaget: Wow you really found all of it, fascinating. Anyway, heres your payment.
sources.6798d6406ad52e1849131aee successMessaget: No trace? Shit... Well, I guess it's time to get help from others now. You will still receive your payment, I will contact you whenever I get more information on this. Give me some time, maybe half an hour, more or less.
sources.6798d8529b81f1d84eac7c67 successMessaget: So, what did he say, didn't he ask them anything? Shit... Well what information did you find then? So they were driven to the main city, hmm... that's not good at all since we avoid that place. I guess we'll have to get our information from somewhere else.
sources.6798e18f1094b3f0d0978e8e successMessaget: So, got anything? Is that a letter from one of them? Fantastic, I'll read through it and report back to you once I need your help again, make sure to pick up your reward.
sources.67990658c4c1cec1f75c13ba successMessaget: PMC bodies inside the exfil? That must be them... What a pity. Well now that this part is solved, we have to move on, we can't let that slide you know? And a letter? I suppose it had to be written by my guys, I'll take a look at it.
sources.6799286d2c0cbcd521bf44dd successMessaget: All set? Good, I guess now it's time to wait for a response.
sources.679b8e71679cb913c9103bee successMessaget: Fantastic! You got it, amazing work soldier, I'll go through all the info from the letter, some photos were also included. Expect me to contact you again soon.
sources.679b97a57b4662b8eac3540a successMessaget: Oh, a laptop with information? Fantastic, let me take a look, maybe I can find something, thank you by the way.
sources.67966e33a1a7e9077af54709 successMessaget: Word got around really fast, you really did a good job out there soldier. Anyway don't forget to pick up your reward, you know where it's stashed.
sources.67966e33a1a7e9077af54709 failMessageText: I told you not to hurt this guy or his gang, no matter how much he deserves it. The fact that these people can't get involved is essential for our plan to work, take a break and then try again.
sources.6796764b2cf9f076f16717d4 successMessaget: All done? Fantastic, we are still not done yet, I will contact you when the next job is ready.
sources.6796764b2cf9f076f16717d4 failMessageText: Hey! Leave these people alone, we can't afford anymore attention, especially not by the guy who we want to frame, try again when the situation cooled down.
sources.67967b160fcf8aff0d6447d2 successMessaget: Flash drive plugged in? So we're good to go, alright, and now we wait, I managed to spread the word around a bit more now, I hope someone important gets involved, then we'll have one less loose end.
sources.67975a790a4f9c2f44fe2911 successMessaget: All set? Perfect, I guess it ain't our problem anymore, well done soldier.
sources.67488670a9bfa58a5cedbf78 successMessaget: Great, let me see what we can do about this lightkeeper guy. Maybe we can agree on something after all? Or maybe not, maybe it will turn out bad for us... Anyway, don't forget your payment, and good luck out there soldier.
sources.674884a3ebf5b8cdbf739bd8 successMessaget: Good job, and now we wait for a response... And don't forget to pick up your payment.
sources.674884a3ebf5b8cdbf739bd8 failMessageText: Ughhh... We have been through this warrior, we need to leave the last one alive. Look for a new group.
sources.6747b8d6b8b522e15a7aa392 successMessaget: Very well then, you are a real expert at Tarkov business, hmm?
sources.6747b920719aa1658981f7d1 successMessaget: Well, looks like you are the perfect person to work with. Don't forget to check out our special stock, keep in mind that some things have their price.
sources.677b4541f0e406dc6526e7aa successMessaget: Yeah I think that's enough for now, thanks for helping out here, I hope that will save a lot of trouble.
sources.6747b9fb1a03abf3f630ae1f successMessaget: Yes we got the deal, thanks a lot. We can make way more money out of this, believe me.
sources.6747b9fb1a03abf3f630ae1f failMessageText: What?? I really did not expect this from you. You better not do something like that in the future again. All this trust earning for what?
sources.6747ba84ea3a80b532e68ad6 successMessaget: Are these all? Wow they look so cool.. Thank you warrior.
sources.67f0fe25a1cd83e3b2ec082f successMessaget: So, all done? Good, oh and by the way if you are looking for better ammunition it's your lucky day! We just got new types of ammo in stock.
sources.676ace5f69e9afec028e5221 successMessaget: So, how's your shoulder? Take some rest, we're sending your payment right now.
sources.6747bfd667581ad41fc4a9de successMessaget: Great, he sends his regards and we both sent you a little gift.
sources.676b0de9ab6151bd15ce350e successMessaget: Good job, and don't forget your payment warrior.
sources.6747c136681e886c4f32ec2d successMessaget: He is satisfied with your work, nice one warrior, your payment is also on the way.
sources.6747c182942fe0faa5478a5e successMessaget: The results were good, he is sending your payment right now, good job.
sources.6747c236e7360000d2cdffb9 successMessaget: Thank you again. I will let someone inspect the guns you brought, lets hope they are in good condition. Oh great you also brought the ration packs? Good to know I got people that I can rely on, here take this.
sources.674880a157d7033368abfe10 successMessaget: Everything looking alright? Good, these exfils will come in handy for our little operation. Anyway, you payment is on the way soldier.
sources.674881a4c92b70c1d05f7f84 successMessaget: Well done soldier, these assholes got what they deserved after all, thanks to you of course. Glad that there can be justice in such a lawless place after all.
sources.674882212efab0d994eabacb successMessaget: Very well then, how did the optics perform? I hope they worked flawlessly, I don't want to sell garbage after all.
sources.674882b91e3043f208409ba5 successMessaget: Impressive skills, prapor and jaeger would be proud for sure, good job soldier.
sources.674dd931e687ffb6dba76b68 successMessaget: Well done, and good job. I already have an idea what to do with the bag... Anyway here's your payment.
sources.6769f36baded384a687d97a1 successMessaget: There you are, so how was it? Good gun right? Don't worry, we have a few more tasks for you, and don't forget your payment.
sources.6769f51c43d1569d59e3c397 successMessaget: Got them all? Fantastic, you know where to find your payment.
sources.6769f68fa4eb1eafdf31d38c successMessaget: Excellent, so do you think this weapon deserves more love or should it stay where it's at? But don't tell prapor if you hate it.
sources.676aca14fe90a5a838dd04c3 successMessaget: Good, maybe this round isn't too bad after all, wouldn't you say?
sources.676acb5bc60f9d06283a2234 successMessaget: You came back faster than we expected, no offense of course. Anyway, good rifles right? What a question, we know how good these guns are, the demand speaks for itself.
sources.67472503ea7a07fc5c20b8a4 successMessaget: Good work. I will try and see if your info benefits us. Also don't forget your payment.
sources.674725ff49d0b6a4089163d2 successMessaget: Those should do it, thank you.
sources.6747268e69275427dffb78f7 successMessaget: Hahaha nice! They have to deal with the heat from all the locals and some of the PMCs now. Great work again.
sources.674727f9beeec883a8b733e4 successMessaget: I hope nobody annoyed you while checking all the spots out, hmm? Well, anyway you know that nothing is easy around here, and don't forget your payment.
sources.674728d52fe62c289180baf3 successMessaget: Good job soldier, I will inform you once the rumor is spreading.
sources.67472a02e64a37a015c27d4a successMessaget: Amazing work! I just got reports of major fights in the region, I hope that these gangs will be less of a problem now.
sources.67516c77476efeef09be34a1 successMessaget: Looks fine to me at least, it should do the job just right. Thank you warrior.
sources.6751718a8b3f5b546858efb2 successMessaget: Great! That looks just like it was picked up from a bandit, perfect!
sources.6751751f0e38a97dbe6a3d91 successMessaget: Fantastic, so iconic, but I think that should be it for now..
sources.67618f93c508b3ae798a0239 successMessaget: Already done? Well done soldier, I'll contact you with more work soon.
sources.675a456b801bb92dae60542e successMessaget: Alright then, it has all the things I asked for, good job. You got access to SKS receivers now, have fun.
sources.67618aad83c2ba931e036514 successMessaget: Great! They look great, I hope they will server their purpose well.
